jobs.title: Project Manager (ESS USMS)
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**


Headquartered in Washington, DC, Versar Global Solutions provides full mission lifecycle solutions for challenges faced by our government and commercial Customers in the natural, built, and digital environments. With team members around the world and a rich legacy spanning more than 50 years, Versar Global Solutions delivers a broad array of planning, analysis and risk management solutions, project and program management, operations and maintenance services, and information technology applications for environmental management and remediation projects, mission critical facilities and installations, and in support of readiness and contingency operations.

**Who You Are:**


Versar is seeking a full\-time Project Manager (PM) to support physical Electronic Security System (ESS) installation projects nationwide in support of the United States Marshals Service (USMS). The ideal candidate will be self\-motivated with the ability to work independently with some oversite. Additionally, the candidate must have experience with the performance and supervision of tasks related to electronic security systems (i.e., Access Control, CCTV, Video Management, Intrusion Detection, Intercoms etc.), and in managing the performance of projects, including people, schedule, scope, quality control, and budget. Further, the candidate will have experience working with other trades, i.e., construction, IT, and client stakeholders. The PM will be the senior subject matter expert and monitor, control and report status on cost, schedule and performance.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Provide overall management of multiple projects mainly on customer sites with some availability for remote work. Extensive travel will be required around the project schedules.
* Meet or exceed client project execution requirements through effective allocation of resources, and by ensuring high quality work, following budget and schedule parameters.
* Manage internal resources and subcontractors. This includes, but is not limited to, verifying quality of installation and deliverables, evaluating percent complete for subcontracted tasks, evaluating equipment and materials used to ensure compliance with contractual requirements and standards, validating invoices for payment, negotiating costs, and managing scope change.
* Ensure contractual compliance with all installation activities, deliverables, and schedule.
* Manage and document inventory of all equipment and material purchased for the project and/or shipped to the project site for installation.
* Ensure internal project management procedures are followed, including project revenue forecasting and estimate at completion.
* Ensure all projects are carried out safely in accordance with Versar’s safety requirements.
* Meet with and/or report weekly to internal and external stakeholder entities.

**What You’ll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree with 3\-5 years of verifiable project management experience.
* Proficiency with MS Office programs, including Word, Excel, and Project.
* Professional experience in the systems administration field with three years of overall experience in Microsoft Windows client and server operating systems.
* Certifications, or have the capability to obtain certifications, in Hirsch, Bosch BVMS, and Bosch IDS, and experience with Commend, Aiphone, Inovonics, and networks.
* Prior experience as a project manager for ESS projects with a full understanding of managing clients, financials, vendor relationships, subcontractors, and project level staff.
* Public Trust clearance requirements.
* US Citizenship required.

**Preferred Requirements:**

* Minimum five (5\) years of experience with electronic security systems, specifically hands\-on experience in installing, configuring, maintaining, and resolving issues with Intrusion Detection Systems, Access Control Systems and Video Management Systems.

**Compensation**


Expected Salary: $100,000 to $120,000 per year


Versar Global Solutions provides the compensation range and general description of other compensation and benefits that the Company in good faith believes it might pay and/or offer for this position based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities in addition to internal equity and geographic location. The Company reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s status protected by local, state, or federal law.

**Location Requirements**


The position will primarily work on sites throughout the country with remote work when possible, during certain project phases. Extensive travel is probable around the project schedule.

**EEO Commitment**


Versar Global Solutions is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.


Versar Global Solutions expressly prohibits any form of unlawful employee harassment based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran.  **Summary:**


We are seeking a detail\-oriented and analytically driven Business Operations Specialist to join a high\-performing team responsible for supporting sales partners in managing and maintaining client books of business. In this fully remote, staff augmentation role, you will play a critical part in ensuring the accuracy of organizational data, client alignment, and segment integrity across internal systems. A typical day involves partnering with Sales, Operations, and Business Analytics teams to process and validate data changes that support critical sales planning activities — reviewing datasets, reconciling discrepancies, troubleshooting escalations, and ensuring the accuracy of account, territory, quota, and organizational data. You will collaborate with stakeholders across global regions, support reporting and analysis requests, and contribute to process improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency and data quality. This role combines analytical problem\-solving, operational execution, and cross\-functional collaboration in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment handling approximately 1,000 change requests per fiscal year.

* Review and approve contracts, cost proposals, and contract supplements to ensure compliance and accuracy
* Approve project and work breakdown structures in alignment with organizational goals
* Review, document, and approve business process documentation
* Approve project budgets and expenditures, and monitor transaction controls and costs against budgets
* Predict potential budget overruns and proactively offer data\-driven solutions
* Process and validate high\-volume data change requests including book and client updates, personnel changes, and LOA processing
* Reconcile data discrepancies and resolve escalations within internal systems
* Collaborate with Sales, Operations, and Business Analytics teams to support sales planning activities
* Support reporting and analysis requests using tools such as Excel and Power BI

* Prepare sub\-agreements and review sub\-consultant invoices to ensure contract compliance
* Contribute to process improvement initiatives that enhance data quality and operational efficiency

* 8–10 years of experience in business operations, sales operations, analytics, or a closely related field
* Demonstrated experience managing high\-volume change requests or operational workflows
* Background in sales planning, business operations, marketing analytics, or digital advertising strongly preferred
* Proven track record of driving process improvements and supporting strategic business initiatives
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional and globally distributed stakeholder teams
* Bachelor's degree in Business Management, Economics, Finance, Accounting, or a relevant field required
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, PivotTables, data validation, and large dataset management

* Solid understanding of business and management principles including strategic planning, resource allocation, and production methods

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong attention to detail
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and operate with minimal supervision

jobs.title: Program Manager, Global Workforce Strategy (Contract)
jobs.description:
US \- Remote
People
Remote
Contract
\*\* This is a contract role. **Duration**: suggested 6 months, with an option to extend. **Hours:** 20\-30 per week\*\*  

  

**Company Overview**
--------------------


Function Health is the AI operating system for health, designed to empower people to live 100 healthy years. We are redefining how individuals understand, measure, and improve their health by moving beyond the limitations of traditional care and enabling comprehensive, continuous insight into human biology. Function has been recognized as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies of 2024, and is venture\-backed by Redpoint and other leading venture firms. Over half a million members have joined Function to take control of their health.  

  

Through comprehensive lab testing, MRI and CT imaging, longitudinal data, and guidance from AI and clinical teams, Function gives members a complete and continuous view of their health — and the clarity to act on it. Through acquisitions across imaging, mobile phlebotomy, and supplement tracking and optimization, Function is building an integrated health platform that spans the full path from testing to health clarity to daily action.  

  

Function recently announced a $298M Series B and is entering its next chapter of growth. As we scale, the quality and durability of our People systems, data, and insights will directly shape our ability to attract, retain, and support exceptional talent.  

  

We are growing our team and seeking out world\-class talent that deeply believes in our mission to positively impact global health, has a relentless bias toward action, and a growth mindset. Function fosters a collaborative and dynamic environment where every day we build the future.  

  

**Role**
--------

As Function Health expands globally, with active hiring in LATAM, momentum in the UK, and plans for further international growth, we are establishing a strategic foundation to support our international workforce. To ensure long\-term success, we are proactively designing a scalable, compliant, and optimized global operating model.  

  

We are seeking a contractor to lead our global workforce strategy workstream. In this role, you will serve as the project manager and strategic connective tissue across People, Legal, Finance, Tax, and business leadership. You will build comprehensive cost\-benefit analyses to identify the optimal engagement model for each market, drive key strategic decisions to closure, and establish a clear, repeatable framework that empowers our team to scale sustainably for the future.  

  

This is a hands\-on delivery role, not an advisory one. Success looks like decisions made, guardrails published, and a repeatable playbook in place by the end of the engagement.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Own the global workforce strategy work stream end to end \- scope, plan, milestones, risks, and status reporting to leadership.
* Build a comprehensive cost\-benefit analysis across our international footprint, covering contractor\-to\-EOR conversions, new EOR implementations, and the threshold at which standing up a legal entity is the better long\-term investment.
* Develop a scalable decision framework for choosing between contractor, EOR, and entity models, weighted for cost, compliance risk, speed, candidate experience, and long\-term operating complexity.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment across People, Legal, Finance, Tax, and business leaders \- surfacing tradeoffs, forcing the open questions, and getting to a decision rather than another meeting.
* Support UK expansion, including evaluation and potential entity creation, on a timeline that lands before year\-end.
* Partner with engineering leadership on LATAM hiring plans, giving them the data and framework to evaluate tradeoffs before commitments are made.
* Define clear guardrails and operating principles for contractor engagements including eligibility for employee programs, benefits, and equity.
* Establish lightweight governance: intake process, decision rights, escalation path, and turnaround expectations, so requests stop being handled reactively.
* Document everything and run a clean handoff \- playbooks, templates, and decision logs that outlast the engagement.
  

  

**Qualifications**
------------------


* 7\+ years in program or project management with direct ownership of international workforce, global mobility and expansion, or global HR operations initiatives.
* Hands\-on experience with EOR platforms and implementations, contractor engagement models, and the economics and mechanics of establishing legal entities in a new market.
* Working knowledge of the risk landscape: worker classification, permanent establishment, payroll and employment tax, work authorization, benefits, and statutory requirements.
* Direct experience working with LATAM and the UK markets.
* Strong financial modeling instincts. Able to build a defensible fully\-loaded cost comparison across models and markets, and explain it to a CFO.
* Proven ability to drive alignment and decisions across senior stakeholders without formal authority.
* Crisp written communication; comfortable writing the exec memo and the operating doc with equal quality.
* Ability to move fast in an ambiguous, high\-growth environment and bring structure without adding bureaucracy.
  

  

**Nice to have**
----------------


* Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry
* Prior work at a company scaling from first international hires to a multi\-entity footprint.
* Familiarity with equity administration across contractor and EOR populations.
  

  

**To be a strong fit, you embody our Core Values**
--------------------------------------------------


* Ruthless Prioritization:
	+ We don’t let perfect get in the way of progress.
	+ We move quickly to drive value, not perfection.
	+ We prioritize what drives impact.
	+ We never compromise on standards of excellence.
*

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Concordia Consulting Group (CCG) is a private, small business based in the Washington, DC, area. CCG was founded in 2024, specializing in providing innovative business solutions and expert consulting services to federal government agencies. With a commitment to delivering exceptional results, we collaborate with organizations to streamline operations, enhance efficiency, and drive growth. We value professionalism, adaptability, and a client\-first approach to ensure sustainable success. Joining Concordia means becoming part of a company that fosters collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.

**Position Overview**

CCG is seeking an experienced Project Manager to support the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Section 508 Support Services task order. The DHS Office of the Chief Information Officer, Experience and Accessibility Directorate (EAD) sets the Department's vision and strategic direction for ensuring that all Information and Communications Technology (ICT) procured, maintained, or used by DHS is accessible to employees and customers with disabilities. In this role, you will serve as the single point of contact to the Contracting Officer and Contracting Officer's Representative, direct all contractor support work performed under the Statement of Work, and manage the schedule, staffing, deliverables, and reporting that keep the Section 508 program running across the Department.

**Responsibilities**

* **Government Interface:** Serve as the single point of contact for the Contracting Officer and the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR), remain available by telephone between 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. EST Monday through Friday, and respond to requests to discuss or resolve technical problems within 24 hours of notification.
* **Reporting:** Provide a monthly progress report to the Contracting Officer and COR by the 15th day of the following month, summarizing all contractor work performed, labor hours by category, direct costs by line item, technical progress, schedule status, and any contractor concerns or recommendations.
* **Stakeholder Engagement:** Meet virtually with the COR and other designated federal personnel to present deliverables, discuss progress, exchange information, and resolve emergent technical issues.
* **Events and Outreach:** Support events and activities requiring presentations or contractor presence, ensuring all materials are prepared, delivered, accessible, and retrieved efficiently.
* **Deliverable Quality and Compliance:** Ensure all written reports and deliverables are accurate, on time, Section 508 conformant, and compatible with DHS workstations and Microsoft Office applications, and ensure contractor personnel understand and follow DHS rules, regulations, and policies governing conduct, safety, and security.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Minimum of three years of experience managing projects of similar size and complexity.
* Experience managing federal government contracts or task orders and serving as the primary point of contact to a Contracting Officer and Contracting Officer's Representative.
* Demonstrated experience producing standard project management deliverables, including project plans, staffing plans, business continuity plans, and recurring monthly progress and status reports.
* Experience planning, staffing, and managing distributed or fully remote technical teams, including recruitment, retention, and replacement of personnel.
* Working knowledge of Section 508 of the Rehabilitation Act, the Revised Section 508 Standards (36 CFR Part 1194\), and WCAG 2\.0 Level A and AA success criteria as they apply to ICT.
* Ability to track cost, schedule, and technical performance and report status clearly to both technical staff and senior government leadership.
* Ability to produce written deliverables that meet Section 508 standards for electronic content, with strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to read, write, speak, and understand English.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent.
* Experience supporting a DHS component or another federal Office of the Chief Information Officer, particularly an IT accessibility or Section 508 program.
* Familiarity with the DHS Trusted Tester program, the DHS Section 508 Playbook, or IAAP certifications such as CPACC or WAS.
* Experience with ServiceNow\-based ticketing and reporting platforms, such as the Accessibility Compliance Management System (ACMS).
* Experience supporting IT governance and acquisition review processes, such as IT Acquisition Reviews (ITARs) or change control boards

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Project Management, or a related field, or equivalent certifications. Advanced degree (MS/PhD) strongly preferred.

**Clearance Requirements**

U.S. Citizenship

**Work Location**

Remote

**Compensation**

The salary range for this position is $95,000 \- $125,000\. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

**Benefits Overview**

Concordia Consulting Group is committed to providing its employees with competitive salaries and benefits in order to increase employee satisfaction and productivity.

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance
* 401k matching

All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

jobs.title: EverCommerce Payments - Senior Project Manager (Remote US)
jobs.description:
EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically\-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service\-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end\-to\-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications. Learn more at EverCommerce.com.


We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here: https://www.evercommerce.com/about\-us/careers/


Our solutions support the full lifecycle of running a service business, from scheduling and dispatching work, to estimating, invoicing, and payments, to customer communication, reputation management, and business insights. Together, these connected solutions help service pros win more jobs, save time, and build stronger, more resilient businesses.


We are seeking a highly proactive Senior Project Manager to join the EverCommerce Payments PMO. This organization is focused on delivering unparalleled value to our customers through frictionless embedded payments and commerce solutions at scale. You will play a key role delivering projects to drive scalable growth across the EverCommerce Solution Organizations. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast\-paced environments, takes extreme ownership of complex initiatives, and confidently drives cross\-functional teams toward successful delivery. You will lead high\-visibility payment initiatives spanning product, engineering, operations, customer success, and executive leadership while ensuring projects remain on track and stakeholders remain accountable.


**Responsibilities:**


* Serve as the single point of accountability for multiple strategic payment initiatives from initiation through successful delivery.
* Drive accountability with cross\-functional teams, ensuring commitments are met regardless of organizational level or reporting structure.
* Identify project risks early, proactively remove blockers, and escalate issues with mitigation plans and recommended solutions.
* Lead executive\-level status meetings with confidence, providing concise updates, clear decisions, and actionable next steps.
* Maintain complete ownership of project plans, dependencies, risks, decisions, and action items.
* Build scalable project governance through clear plans, transparent reporting, proactive risk management, and actionable executive communications.
* Build and maintain positive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Lead project retrospectives to identify areas for improvement and implement changes as necessary.

**Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:**


* Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, computer science, related field and/or PMP is preferred
* Minimum of 5\+ years of experience in project management
* Experience delivering complex payment processing, merchant onboarding, or embedded payment integrations is strongly preferred
* Advanced proficiency with Asana is required. Candidate should have experience building project plans, managing dependencies, dashboards, reporting, automations, portfolios, and executive reporting
* Comfortable presenting to Directors, Vice Presidents, and executive leadership while facilitating difficult conversations, resolving conflicts, and driving decisions.
* Ability to operate effectively with ambiguity and create structure where one does not yet exist.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize competing initiatives in a rapidly changing environment.
* Demonstrated history of successfully delivering multiple complex, cross\-functional initiatives with measurable business outcomes.

**Where:** This is a remote, US based position, some travel required for quarterly events and on\-sight partner meetings. The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Jordan, New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States – if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in\-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.


**Benefits and Perks**


* Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in\-office, remote, or hybrid
* Day 1 access to a robust health and wellness benefits, including an annual wellness stipend
* 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting
* Flexible and generous (FTO) time\-off
* Employee Stock Purchase Program

**Compensation****:** The target base compensation for this position is $100,000 to $110,000 USD per year in most US locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.


EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience!

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
9th Way Insignia is a service\-disabled, veteran\-owned small business bringing transformative technology to our government customers so they can achieve their missions. Our specialties include cybersecurity, cloud modernization, software development, data analytics, enterprise architecture, enterprise IT, analytics, process automation, and artificial intelligence. Learn more about 9th Way Insignia at https://9thwayinsignia.com/.



Application password: Niner

**Team (Project) Introduction**



We are recruiting for a range of cybersecurity opportunities supporting federal customers, focused on strengthening enterprise security architecture, systems engineering, and the secure implementation of technologies across the environment.



The work involves applying established cybersecurity standards, guidelines, and frameworks to help translate organizational and business requirements into secure, scalable technical solutions. Team members may contribute to security architecture and engineering efforts, implementation guidance, technical analysis, and the development of repeatable approaches that support the consistent deployment and operation of secure technologies across complex enterprise environments.



Systems security engineering is an important component of this work, with an emphasis on incorporating security and stakeholder protection requirements throughout the system development life cycle, from concept and design through development, production, sustainment, and decommissioning. The team will apply established systems engineering and cybersecurity principles to help protect systems, applications, data, and supporting technologies.



Ultimately, this work supports the broader mission to strengthen its cybersecurity posture, reduce organizational risk, and protect critical systems and information from evolving cyber threats, including external adversaries and insider threats.



9th Way Insignia is looking for a Program Manager to join this team.  

  

**Professional Level Information:**  

A Manager at 9th Way Insignia accomplishes department objectives by managing staff and processes and evaluating department activities. Overview:

Please note that this position is contingent upon the successful award of a contract currently under bid.  

Goldbelt Glacier is a trusted industry partner to the Department of the Interior, Bureau of Indian Affairs (BIA). Goldbelt Glacier supports programs administered through the BIA including social services, natural resources management, economic development, law enforcement and detention services, administration of tribal courts, implementation of land and water claim settlements, housing improvement, disaster relief, replacement and repair of schools, repair and maintenance of roads and bridges, and the repair of structural deficiencies on high hazard dams. **Summary:**  

Goldbelt Glacier is seeking a Senior Program Manager to support the Indian Affairs Office of the Chief Financial Officer (OCFO). The Senior Program Manager will provide program management, analysis, process improvement, reporting, and implementation support across OCFO divisions.  

The position will work with OCFO leadership and staff to coordinate priorities and activities, identify and resolve operational issues, analyze data and performance, improve and standardize workflows, and support modernization and AI\-readiness efforts.  

Preference will be given to Alaska Native and/or American Indian applicants. **Location:** Remote/Contractor Site, with potential travel to on\-site locations as needed.  


Responsibilities:

* Coordinate activities, priorities, milestones, dependencies, risks, and issues across multiple OCFO divisions.
* Develop and maintain program trackers covering milestones, tasks, suspense dates, risks, issues, and dependencies.
* Identify workflow problems, bottlenecks, delays, resource constraints, system access issues, and other barriers affecting OCFO operations.
* Conduct root\-cause analysis and develop recommendations to address identified problems.
* Maintain issue and resolution information and track corrective actions through completion.

* Work with OCFO divisions to identify processes that may benefit from AI, automation, or low\-code solutions.

* Support development and evaluation of AI and automation pilots, including requirements, test scripts, metrics, lessons learned, and recommended improvements.
* Assess AI readiness, including data availability, system constraints, workforce adoption, training needs, governance, and security considerations.
* Map current workflows and identify opportunities to eliminate unnecessary manual steps, redundant approvals, inconsistent processes, and other inefficiencies.
* Develop and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), playbooks, workflow maps, templates, quick\-reference guides, decision trees, and job aids.
* Support process improvements using approved tools such as SharePoint, Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate.
* Coordinate with OCFO stakeholders, system administrators, policy leads, and functional experts to support implementation of process improvements.
* Facilitate meetings, working sessions, and cross\-divisional coordination activities.
* Prepare executive\-level reports, briefings, memoranda, talking points, slide presentations, risk summaries, and decision\-support materials.
* Support OCFO audit readiness, reviews, modernization efforts, compliance activities, and other cross\-divisional initiatives

jobs.description:
Prysmian is the world leader in the energy and telecom cable systems industry. Each year, the company manufactures thousands of miles of underground and submarine cables and systems for power transmission and distribution, as well as medium low voltage cables for the construction and infrastructure sectors. We also produce a comprehensive range of optical fibers, copper cables and connectivity for voice, video and data transmission for the telecommunication sector.


We are 30,000 employees, across 50\+ countries. Everyone at Prysmian has the potential to make their mark; because whatever you do, wherever you are based, you will be part of a company that is helping transform the world around us.


Make Your Mark at Prysmian!

The Regional Manufacturing Learning \& Development Specialist will lead the deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement of the Dozuki digital work instruction and training platform across manufacturing facilities in North America. * **Experience:** 5\+ years of related experience (healthcare, payer operations, systems analysis, or federal program support preferred)
* **Technical skills:** Requirements management, workflow/process modeling, EDI analysis, cross‑system integration validation, Jira/Confluence/Azure DevOps, and understanding of eligibility and claims systems

Through a partnership\-based approach, Coterie helps insurance professionals unlock untapped revenue in the small commercial space. jobs.title: Math, Accounting, Computer Science, Data Analyst Background Wanted — $80,000/Year
jobs.description:
Are you extremely good with numbers?

Do you enjoy spreadsheets, analyzing information, solving problems, and figuring out the most efficient way to accomplish something?

**Royal Maintenance Group** is a fast\-growing national contracting and property services company operating across **27 states**, and we're looking for a highly analytical person to join our team.

**You** **do not need previous estimating or industry experience**.

We are specifically interested in candidates with backgrounds or strong interests in areas such as:

* Mathematics
* Accounting
* Finance
* Computer Science
* Engineering
* Economics
* Data Analytics
* Business Analytics

What Will You Actually Be Doing?

Your job will be to help us figure out **what projects should cost**.

Our company manages large commercial projects throughout the country. Before we can price a project for a customer, someone needs to analyze the property, determine what resources will be required, calculate costs, and make sure the project can be completed profitably.

That's where you come in.

You will analyze information such as:

* Property sizes and measurements
* Labor requirements
* Material costs
* Equipment requirements
* Vendor and subcontractor pricing
* Maps and property layouts
* Historical project data
* Project specifications
* Profit margins
* Customer requirements

You'll then use that information to build accurate estimates and pricing models.

Think of the position as a combination of **math, business analysis, problem solving, and project strategy.**

**What We're Looking For:**

We care much more about **how you think** than whether you've worked in our industry before.

**You may be a great fit if:**

* You're naturally good with numbers
* You're extremely detail\-oriented
* You enjoy solving complicated problems
* You're very comfortable using computers
* You're strong with Excel or spreadsheets
* You can look at a lot of information and make sense of it
* You notice details other people miss
* You learn new systems quickly
* You're organized
* You're comfortable making decisions
* You take ownership of your work
* You're ambitious and want to grow

**Previous estimating or construction experience is NOT required.**

We will teach you our industries and how our projects work.

We're looking for someone who can bring the **analytical ability**.

The Projects

You'll work on pricing projects for major commercial properties throughout the United States.

Depending on the season and division, projects may involve:

* Snow and ice management
* Commercial roofing
* Property maintenance
* Facility services
* Other commercial contracting services

One day you might be analyzing the cost to service a portfolio of commercial properties during a snowstorm.

Another day you might be speaking with subcontractors executing the operations.

The industries change.

**The underlying job is the same: analyze the project, understand the numbers, and determine what it should cost.**

Compensation

**$80,000 per year**

Full\-time position.

**Monday through Friday**  
**8:00 AM – 4:00 PM**

Hoboken Office

**1 Newark Street**  
**Hoboken, NJ 07030**

Our office is located just steps from the **Hoboken PATH station**, making it extremely convenient from Manhattan and throughout North Jersey.

Free parking is also available at a nearby parking garage.

No Industry Experience? That's Okay.

We're not necessarily looking for someone who already knows our business.

We're looking for someone who is **smart, analytical, curious, and capable of learning it.**

You'll get exposure to how a large national company prices projects, evaluates profitability, manages vendors, makes operational decisions, and grows into new markets.

**Career Growth**

We're looking for someone who can eventually become much more than an entry\-level analyst.

As you learn the business and demonstrate your abilities, there may be opportunities to advance into:

* Senior Estimating
* Business Analytics
* Pricing Strategy
* Project Management
* Operations
* Division Management
* Senior Management

Royal Maintenance Group is continuing to expand, and we want ambitious people who are interested in growing alongside the company.

If you're highly analytical, great with numbers, and looking for something more entrepreneurial and hands\-on than a traditional accounting or corporate analyst position, **we'd like to hear from you.**

jobs.title: Project Manager REMOTE
jobs.description:
**Location:** Remote (CONUS) with availability during Eastern Time core hours


**Clearance:** Active Secret Clearance required


**Job Type:** Full\-time


**Contract Type:** Government Contract (Base Year \+ 4 Option Years)


### **Position Overview**



We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead a high\-impact contract supporting the Assistant Secretary of the Army for Acquisition, Logistics, and Technology (ASA(ALT)). This role provides overall management and oversight of contractor personnel supporting the Project Management Resource Tool (PMRT) program, which enables program offices to manage financial and programmatic data, automate processes, and provide data visualization for senior\-level decision\-making.



The ideal candidate is a certified project management professional with a proven track record managing Department of Defense (DoD) or Department of the Army (DA) financial and acquisition programs. This position serves as the single accountable manager for task order performance and acts as the primary interface with government leadership, including the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) and the Technical Point of Contact (TPOC).



This is a non\-personal services contract position. The Project Manager reports directly to the Prime Contractor for all human resources, disciplinary, and administrative matters, while receiving work direction and prioritization from government stakeholders.


### **Key Responsibilities**



The Project Manager serves as the single accountable manager for all task order performance, ensuring disciplined execution of approved plans, schedules, and governance processes. This position acts as the primary interface with government stakeholders, including the GSA AAS COR, ASA(ALT) TPOC, and other program authorities, and directs and coordinates cross\-functional contractor teams operating across multiple locations. Regular status briefings are provided to Government leadership on cost, schedule, performance, and risk, with a focus on timely communication, issue escalation, and resolution in support of Government decision\-making.



Contract and performance oversight includes managing and overseeing all activities performed by contractor personnel and subcontractors, ensuring compliance with all Performance Work Statement requirements and deliverables. The Project Manager develops and implements Transition\-In and Transition\-Out plans, coordinates the Project Kick\-Off Meeting and bi\-weekly Technical Status Meetings, and prepares Monthly Status Reports including risk registers and performance metrics. Additionally, this role maintains visibility into accumulated and projected costs, invoiced amounts, and labor utilization.



Quality and risk management responsibilities include administering quality management in accordance with the approved Quality Control Plan, managing risk registers, implementing corrective actions as required, ensuring all deliverables meet Section 508 compliance requirements, and overseeing personnel leave/absence planning and replacement procedures.



Key deliverables include Monthly Status Reports due by the 10th business day of each month, Project Kick\-Off Meeting coordination and minutes, Transition\-In and Transition\-Out Plans, Technical Status Meeting minutes, a Quality Control Plan, and a Personnel Leave/Absent Plan.


### **Required Qualifications**



The Project Manager must be a U.S. citizen with a current active Secret security clearance and possess a current project or program management certification such as PMP or PgMP. This position requires a minimum of five years of recent experience managing programs or supporting DoD financial systems of comparable size, scope, and complexity within the last seven years. Comprehensive knowledge of the Planning, Programming, Budgeting, and Execution (PPBE) process is essential, along with hands\-on experience with GFEBS and other defense business and accounting systems. The Project Manager must also maintain CMMC Level 1 status.



The ideal candidate demonstrates exceptional leadership abilities with a track record of leading cross\-functional teams and communicating effectively with senior government leadership. Strong judgment and the ability to make independent decisions to accomplish goals are essential.


### **Work Conditions**



Core hours are 0900 to 1600 Eastern Time, Monday through Friday. This position may be performed from anywhere CONUS, provided the candidate is readily available during core hours for on\-demand support, status reporting, and issue resolution. The Project Manager is designated as a "Key Person," and any proposed substitution requires written concurrence from the Contracting Officer with substitute qualifications equal to or greater than the original Key Person.


### **Equal Opportunity Employer**



We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Supporting strategic business initiatives, from business plan development through successful execution. Holding PMs accountable for delivery. **Cybersecurity Governance Structure:**  

Manages agenda, membership, reporting, tracking of actions, presentation materials development, and facilitates meetings as necessary and escalation of cybersecurity risk decisions
  
**Decision Support:** Providing decision\-making support through analysis and recommendations and escalation of cyber risk decisions to appropriate committees. Managing stakeholder relationships, serving as a proxy or gatekeeper for the CISO, and synthesizing information for executive decisions.
  
  

**Reports \& Communication:**

They work directly with the shipbuilder for identifying, assembling, managing, directing, and coordinating all resources required for the design, construction, and Test and Evaluation (T\&E) of the future submarine’s power system. They are also responsible for all the Turbine Generators for generating electricity for all submarine and CVNs. The future Ballistic Missile Submarine is the nation’s top defense priority as the only survivable leg of the nuclear triad.  

Len Bunch (www.linkedin.com/in/leonardbunch) leads this team as a Navy veteran. The team has been recognized by the Navy and the industry for their outstanding contributions to the contract and program.  

**In this role, you will:**  

* Support the PM in the day\-to\-day operations within the program to include, but not limited to:
	+ Job Description development
	+ Resume review and interviews
	+ Onboarding processes
	+ Compiling, editing and submission of weekly, monthly and annual reports
	+ Timecard management
	+ Financial management
	+ Employee recognition
* Use your experience, provide support, as needed, to all government and contractor support personnel.
* Work with minimal supervision.
* Demonstrate proficiency in preparing, selecting, organizing, and presenting information concisely.
* Work well within a time sensitive environment.
* Professionally develop junior personnel.
* Research, analyze and provide recommendations on possible courses of action on multiple topics.
* Provide training, as requested by the customer, to government and contractor support personnel on submarine operation, construction, risk management, and certifications.

  

**To be successful in this role, you will have:**  

* A current/active DoD Secret security clearance
* U.S Citizenship.
* A Bachelor’s degree and minimum 5 years of related experience
* An advanced MS Office skillset to include Outlook, PowerPoint, Word, Excel and Teams
* Ability to multi\-task in a fast\-paced environment accepting emergent tasking with little to no supervision and/or direction
* Able to work both independently and within large team environments
* Discretion in performing specified work requirements
* Outstanding written and oral communication skills to communicate effectively and build strong working relationships with a vast team of diverse professionals
* Attention to detail and the ability to meet tight deadlines, as well as work independently and with sufficient knowledge to present projects to senior management
* Ability to travel up to 10%
  

  

### **Company Overview**

  

  

Serco Inc. (Serco) is the Americas division of Serco Group, plc. In North America, Serco’s 9,000\+ employees strive to make an impact every day across 100\+ sites in the areas of Defense, Citizen Services, and Transportation. We help our clients deliver vital services more efficiently while increasing the satisfaction of their end customers. Serco serves every branch of the U.S. military, numerous U.S. Federal civilian agencies, the Intelligence Community, the Canadian government, state, provincial and local governments, and commercial clients. While your place may look a little different depending on your role, we know you will find yours here. Wherever you work and whatever you do, we invite you to discover your place in our world. Serco is a place you can count on and where you can make an impact because every contribution matters.
  

  

To review Serco benefits please visit: https://careers.serco\-na.com/us/en/what\-we\-offer. If you require an accommodation with the application process please email: careers@serco\-na.com or call the HR Service Desk at 800\-628\-6458, option 1\. Please note, due to EEOC/OFCCP compliance, Serco is unable to accept resumes by email.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity – Information System Security Manager (ISSM)
jobs.description:
At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.


The Boeing Company is currently seeking a **Cybersecurity – Information System Security Manager (ISSM)** to join the team in **Herndon, VA**.


The selected candidate will rely on cybersecurity and Information Assurance (IA) background to be a technical leader and support Enterprise activities and Boeing customers throughout multiple classified computing domains. The ISSM is responsible for ensuring all Information System Security policies, standards, and directives are enforced to support assessment, authorization and continued operation of information systems processing classified information.

  

  

**Position Responsibilities:**


* Oversees the development and deployment of program information security for all program systems to meet the program and enterprise requirements, policies, standards, guidelines and procedures (multiple locations)
* Manages assigned team to facilitate effective execution of Risk Management Framework (RMF)
* Provides guidance and coaching to support team within Information Security
* Manages and performs security compliance continuous monitoring
* Oversees and participates in security assessments and audits
* Prepares, reviews, and presents technical reports and briefings
* Identifies root causes, prioritizes threats and recommends and/or implements corrective action
* Explores the enterprise and industry for evolving state of industry knowledge and methods regarding information security best practices
* Leads development of enterprise\-wide information security policies, standards, guidelines and procedures that may reach across multiple stakeholder organizations

**Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):**


* Successfully completed Tier 5 Investigation (T5\), formerly known as a Single Scope Background Investigation (SSBI) by the federal government within the last 5 years, or requires candidate to have been enrolled in a Continuous Vetting program within the last 5 years
* Currently hold certification in good standing to satisfy IAM Level III (CISSP, GSLC, or CISM)
* 5\+ years of combined experience and education in IT, cybersecurity, or related fields
* 3\+ years of experience utilizing security relevant tools, systems, and applications in support of Risk Management Framework (RMF) to include NESSUS, ACAS, DISA STIGs, SCAP, Audit Reduction, and HBSS
* 3\+ years of experience with cybersecurity leadership overseeing programs and teams, authorizing risk decisions, coordinating stakeholders, and improving security and compliance
* 3\+ years of experience communicating complex technical risks, translating impact, and advising senior leaders
* Experience in cybersecurity policies and implementation of Risk Management Framework (RMF): e.g. DAAPM, CNSSI 1253, ICD\-503, JSIG, or NIST SP 800 series
* Ability to travel 10% \- 20% of the time

**Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):**


* 5\+ years of experience as an information system security officer (ISSO) or information system security manager (ISSM) supporting classified programs
* 5\+ years of experience utilizing security relevant tools, systems, and applications in support of Risk Management Framework (RMF) to include NESSUS, ACAS, DISA STIGs, SCAP, Audit Reduction, and HBSS
* 5\+ years of experience cybersecurity leadership overseeing programs and teams, authorizing risk decisions, coordinating stakeholders, and improving security and compliance.
* 5\+ years of experience communicating complex technical risks, translating impact, and advising senior leaders.

**Conflict of Interest:**


Successful candidates for this job must satisfy the Company’s Conflict of Interest (COI) assessment process.


**Drug Free Workplace:**


Boeing is a Drug Free Workplace where post offer applicants and employees are subject to testing for marijuana, cocaine, opioids, amphetamines, PCP, and alcohol when criteria are met as outlined in our policies.


**Pay \& Benefits:**


At Boeing, we strive to deliver a Total Rewards package that will attract, engage and retain the top talent. Elements of the Total Rewards package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities.


The Boeing Company also provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work.


The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.


Pay is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.


Summary pay range: $140,250 – $189,750

  

  

Applications for this position will be accepted until **Sept. 15, 2026**

  

  

**Export Control Requirements:**

This position must meet U.S. export control compliance requirements. To meet U.S. export control compliance requirements, a “U.S. Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. §120\.62 is required. “U.S. Person” includes U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.


**Export Control Details:**

US based job, US Person required


**Relocation**

This position offers relocation based on candidate eligibility.


**Security Clearance**

This position requires an active U.S. Top Secret/SCI Security Clearance (U.S. Citizenship Required). (A U.S. Security Clearance that has been active in the past 24 months is considered active)


**Visa Sponsorship**

Employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status.

Peraton is a next\-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
As a leader in Lawful and Location Intelligence, SS8 helps make societies safer. Our commitment is to extract, analyze, and visualize the critical intelligence that gives law enforcement, intelligence agencies, and emergency services the real\-time insights that help save lives. Our high performance, flexible, and future\-proof solutions also enable mobile network operators to achieve regulatory compliance with minimum disruption, time, and cost. SS8 is trusted by the largest government agencies, communications providers, and systems integrators globally.

**Overview**



We are seeking a Senior Project Manager to join our team and to support the full lifecycle of U.S. Government opportunities and programs—from early customer engagement and proposal development through contracting, project execution, customer adoption, and long\-term relationship management.  

This role will serve as a critical bridge between SS8's Government Sales organization, customers, partners, Engineering, Product Management, Contracts, and other internal stakeholders. The ideal candidate combines strong program management and communication skills with experience supporting government customers, bids and proposals, contracts, and technology\-driven programs.  

Depending on project demands, the role may spend significant periods supporting the sales process but will transition to project / program delivery as their core function and priority when required.  

This individual does not need to be a telecommunications engineer but must be technically savvy, comfortable learning complex software and technology environments, and capable of translating between technical teams, business stakeholders, and government customers.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Project \& Program Execution**


* Lead cross\-functional teams responsible for the successful deployment, integration, testing, acceptance, and operationalization of SS8 software and services.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans with clearly defined milestones, responsibilities, dependencies, and deliverables.
* Manage project risks, issues, schedules, resources, dependencies, and mitigation plans.
* Manage the requirements lifecycle and ensure alignment between customer expectations, contractual commitments, and technical implementation.
* Coordinate acceptance testing and ensure completion of contractual deliverables and customer acceptance criteria.
* Manage project scope and support the development and execution of change requests when requirements evolve.
* Provide regular program status updates to customers and SS8 leadership.
* Follow established program governance, schedules, responsibilities, communication plans, and internal/customer reporting processes.
* Track contract deliverables, modifications, funding actions, option periods, and other milestones that may impact program execution.
* Conduct lessons\-learned sessions and track resulting actions in order to incorporate findings into future programs and proposals.


**Customer Success \& Relationship Management**


* Serve as a primary point of coordination for customers throughout program execution.
* Maintain regular communication with government stakeholders to ensure visibility into progress, risks, decisions, and upcoming milestones.
* Work proactively to identify and resolve customer concerns before they impact program success.
* Help customers understand SS8 capabilities and identify opportunities to increase utilization or apply SS8 technology to additional mission requirements.
* Partner with Sales leadership to support account planning, follow\-on opportunities, contract renewals, and program expansion.
* Maintain awareness of customer priorities, funding cycles, procurement activities, and organizational changes that may affect the program or broader account.


**Contract \& Program Transition**


* Support the transition of awarded opportunities from Sales and Capture into formal project / program execution.
* Review contract requirements, Statements of Work, deliverables, milestones, reporting obligations, and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate with Contracts, Finance, Engineering, Product, Sales, and partners to ensure contractual and operational requirements are understood.


**Government Opportunity \& Customer Support**


* Support Government Sales leadership throughout the opportunity lifecycle, from initial customer engagement through contract award and execution.
* Assist in preparing customer communications, capability briefs, white papers, presentations, meeting materials, and follow\-up actions.
* Participate in customer discovery sessions to understand mission requirements, operational challenges, technical environments, procurement considerations, and desired outcomes.
* Maintain continuity between pre\-award customer conversations and post\-award execution to ensure commitments and requirements are understood and delivered.
* Develop trusted relationships with government customers, industry partners, integrators, and other program stakeholders.
* Identify follow\-on requirements, expansion opportunities, and emerging customer needs during program execution.


**Capture, Bid \& Proposal Support**


* Coordinate and support responses to RFIs, RFQs, RFPs, solution briefs, Sources Sought notices, and other government acquisition activities.
* Manage proposal schedules, compliance matrices, action items, contributors, reviews, and submission requirements.
* Work with Sales, Engineering, Product Management, Contracts, and partners to translate customer requirements into executable technical and programmatic solutions.
* Support development and review of Statements of Work, technical approaches, implementation plans, schedules, deliverables, assumptions, and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain reusable proposal content, past performance information, program documentation, and other government business collateral.
* Help ensure commitments made during the sales and proposal process

Peraton is a next\-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.


##### **Program Overview**


The program is an IDIQ contract for an AWS\-based cloud hosting system. Currently, Peraton is supporting the Cloud Security, IoT, and AIML use cases for the environment in a hybrid work environment with Federal employees. Peraton also support the following applications as part of the environment: Dremio, Tableau, Globus, Posit/RStudio, Atlassian, ThingLogix, Alteryx and CloudCheckr.

Peraton's Department of the Interior (DOI), U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS), and NOAA's National Marine Fisheries Service (NMFS) have identified a critical gap in the federal government's ability to conduct comprehensive Endangered Species Act (ESA) research. While FWS operates an authoritative web\-based platform for managing data for terrestrial and freshwater species, it does not currently include NMFS marine and anadromous species data forcing agencies to rely on separate, manual processes. This program closes that gap by integrating marine and anadromous species data into the existing FWS platform, creating a single, unified experience for all ESA\-listed species.

  

Peraton is seeking a **Lead Business Analyst** to serve as the senior BA lead on a federal environmental data integration program. In this role, you will bring expertise in Endangered Species Act \- Section 7 consultation processes and federal environmental platform workflows to drive requirements, compliance validation, and cross\-agency coordination at the highest level.

  

**Work Location:** Remote

* Lead requirements elicitation and documentation for all platform changes including species display, decision logic updates, template updates, and consultation routing
* Conduct gap analysis between current platform capabilities and integration requirements, documenting findings for technical deliverables
* Facilitate joint requirements workshops with the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS) Ecological Services and NOAA Fisheries SMEs
* Lead the development of consultation logic alignment documentation for joint agency use
* Support compliance validation by verifying that species list generation, decision logic, template content, and consultation routing meet regulatory requirements
* Coordinate with government SMEs to obtain required approvals and sign\-offs on compliance\-critical deliverables
* Lead pilot consultation workflow design, defining scenarios covering all consultation types
* Analyze pilot results and live consultation feedback, translating findings into actionable system updates
* Lead the development of the Pilot Report with Metrics, capturing consultation cycle times, completion rates, defect summaries, and actionable findings from pilot workflow execution
* Lead the development of the Endangered Species Act \- Section 7 Compliance Validation Checklist, documenting validation criteria for species list generation accuracy, decision logic correctness, template content completeness, and consultation routing
* Coordinate government review and acceptance of Updated DKeys and Consultation Package Builder Assets, ensuring all content meets regulatory requirements and agency sign\-off is obtained
* Contribute to final operational documentation and year\-end reporting

**Basic Qualifications**


* Bachelors degree and 10 years professional experience or a Masters degree and 8 years professional experience or an Associates degree and 12 years professional experience; or a high school diploma/equivalent and 16 years’ professional experience.
* U.S. Citizenship required; must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance
* Extensive years of business analysis experience on federal IT programs
* Expertise in Endangered Species Act \- Section 7 consultation processes
* Experience with federal environmental regulatory systems and multi\-agency coordination
* Strong requirements elicitation, documentation, and stakeholder facilitation skills
* Experience supporting compliance validation activities on federal programs
* Experience capturing and reporting pilot metrics including cycle times, completion rates, and defect summaries
* Experience facilitating OMB or executive\-level government reviews and demonstration preparation

**Preferred Qualifications**


* CBAP or equivalent BA certification preferred
* Direct experience with the FWS Information for Planning and Consultation (IPaC) platform, Ecological Services, or NOAA Fisheries systems
* Experience with DOI, FWS, or NOAA Fisheries programs
* Familiarity with data migration or system integration projects in a federal context
* Active Public Trust Clearance

##### **Your Impact**


Own your opportunity to support our nation's defense. Make an impact by connecting and securing critical operations across the globe, keeping our country safe and secure.


**Job Description**
-------------------


**YOUR IMPACT**


Own your opportunity to work with the largest government agency in the nation. Make an impact by advancing the Department of War’s mission to keep our country safe and secure.

  

**OUR COMPANY**


Iron EagleX (IEX), a wholly owned subsidiary of General Dynamics Information Technology (GDIT), delivers agile IT and Intelligence solutions. Combining small\-team flexibility with global scale, IEX leverages emerging technologies to provide innovative, user\-focused solutions that empower organizations and end users to operate smarter, faster, and more securely in dynamic environments.

  

**JOB DESCRIPTION**


Iron EagleX is seeking a Senior Principal Intelligence Analyst to support our analytics teams in Crystal City, VA. In this role, you will conduct advanced all\-source analysis while working closely with multi\-discipline analysts, data scientists, data engineers, and developers to improve the speed, depth, and quality of analytic production. You will apply expert analytic tradecraft to interpret complex information from multiple sources, identify patterns and gaps, develop defensible assessments, and help shape data\-driven approaches to mission problems. You will help translate analytic questions into data requirements, evaluate the usefulness of data outputs, provide subject matter context for models and tools, and ensure that technical capabilities remain aligned to impactful analytics.

  

**MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT**


As a Senior Principal Intelligence Analyst, you will help transform complex, multi\-source information into clear, timely, and actionable assessments that support decision\-making. Your work will directly influence how data, analytics, and AI\-enabled tools are applied to real\-world intelligence problems. By working closely with data scientists, engineers, developers, and analysts, you will help ensure that emerging technical capabilities are grounded in analytic tradecraft, operational relevance, and mission needs.

  

**JOB DUTIES** (INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO)


* Conduct expert\-level all\-source analysis using structured analytic techniques, intelligence tradecraft, and multiple information sources to produce defensible assessments, insights, and recommendations.
* Analyze complex datasets, reporting streams, operational information, and mission\-relevant source material to identify patterns, trends, anomalies, relationships, risks, and intelligence gaps.
* Collaborate with data scientists, data engineers, developers, and analysts to translate mission questions into data requirements, analytic workflows, technical use cases, and measurable outcomes.
* Provide subject matter expertise to support the design, evaluation, and refinement of data models, analytic tools, AI\-enabled workflows, and decision\-support capabilities.
* Review and assess outputs from data science models, AI tools, search systems, automated extraction processes, and analytic platforms for relevance, accuracy, explainability, and mission value.
* Support the development of analytic methodologies that combine traditional all\-source tradecraft with data\-driven techniques, automated discovery, knowledge management, and AI\-assisted analysis.
* Identify data gaps, quality issues, source limitations, collection shortfalls, and analytic constraints that affect the reliability of assessments or technical outputs.
* Produce written assessments, briefings, analytic notes, and decision\-support products tailored to mission, operational, and technical stakeholders.
* Collaborate with full stack developers and data engineers to ensure analytic workflows, tool interfaces, and data access patterns support realistic analyst needs without assuming responsibility for software development or front\-end implementation.
* Apply rigorous sourcing, confidence levels, assumptions, alternative analysis, and evidence evaluation to ensure analytic products are transparent, credible, and defensible.
* Support the integration of AI\-enabled tools into analytic workflows by testing outputs, identifying failure modes, refining prompts or analytic use cases, and documenting appropriate use cases and limitations.

**REQUIRED SKILLS:**


* Expert\-level experience conducting all\-source analysis in support of intelligence, defense, national security, law enforcement, or mission\-focused operational environments.
* Strong understanding of all\-source analytic tradecraft, including source evaluation, structured analytic techniques, confidence statements, assumption testing, alternative analysis, and intelligence writing standards.
* Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex information from multiple sources into clear, concise, and defensible analytic judgments.
* Experience working with large, complex, or multi\-source datasets in support of analytic production, operational assessments, targeting, threat analysis, network analysis, or mission planning.
* Ability to translate mission questions and analytic problems into data requirements, technical use cases, workflow needs, and evaluation criteria for technical teams.
* Experience collaborating with d
