jobs.title: Counterintelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**


DARPAs All\-Source intelligence/counterintelligence (CI) program includes detecting, identifying, assessing, and, in conjunction with the assigned CI support activity, analyzing information on adversary intentions and capabilities. This may include developing programs, systems, and procedures designed to counter foreign intelligence collection efforts and activities of foreign entities, including sabotage and terrorist activities.


All\-Source/CI analysts recommend cost\-effective protective measures and countermeasures for DARPA personnel, programs, and activities. All\-Source/CI Analyst will enable DARPAs organic intelligence/CI program to realize the positive attributes inherent in combining IC resources with a trained/qualified internal multi\-disciplined security team in applying All\-Source Intelligence/CI context to protecting DARPA programs. This nascent internal structure will develop or adapt existing programs, systems, and procedures to proactively counter foreign intelligence collection efforts and activities, including sabotage and terrorist activities.


The All\-Source/CI Analyst will perform the following responsibilities:

* Determine essential elements of information, and conduct activities to detect, identify, assess, exploit, and proactively counter or neutralize hostile intelligence collection, sabotage, and terrorist activities
* Plan special analytical projects in response to client assignments which include analytical approach, schedule, personnel requirements, data collection, travel, assessment criteria, and costs
* Research and collect required data, perform analysis, and summarize findings in response to client requests
* Compile detailed reports of analysis clearly defining the problem or issue, factors considered, findings, and provide clear, concise conclusions and recommendations
* Develop innovative and proactive analytical methodologies, refining existing program protection analytical methodologies to meet evolving program needs
* Provide intelligence/CI input and assist PSRs, PMs, and SETAs in developing Program Protection Plans
* Review and provide comments on Program Protection Plans, Test Plans, OPSEC Plans, and other planning documentation as required
* Assist Technical Office management, PMs, SETAs, and security personnel in performing SAP lifecycle threat analysis
* Apply analytical methodologies to existing programs to review, and readdress, if necessary, their protection needs to remain consistent with changes in diplomatic, political, and military environments
* Perform short\-notice contingency and exposure analysis, summarizing implications, and providing viable responses and recommended courses of action
* Work with individual program management personnel to assist in analyzing and developing solutions to unique or difficult CI\-related issues
* Review organizational mission statements and associated publicly available information for inconsistencies which may reveal sensitive information
* Review, analyze, and, where appropriate, make recommendations to long\-term program protection policies and practices
* Provide intelligence and CI threat data and analysis to support assessments and surveys of agency\-wide OPSEC programs
* Assist DARPA PMs in identification of program CPI and assist in the development of agency\-wide and program\-specific OPSEC plans, and make recommendations for additions or changes where appropriate
* Participate, as appropriate, in program management and planning meetings, and working sessions to provide an intelligence/CI perspective
* Receive information of CI value from technical security inspections, foreign travel reporting, international relations/security, visitor control, AT/FP, or other sources of potential FIE or CI related activity
* Prepare and deliver comprehensive briefings to increase CI awareness and to inform senior DARPA leadership
* Establish lines of communication and professional relationships with other Federal and DoD agencies within the IC
* Other duties as assigned




**Required Skills (Knowledge, Skills, Abilities)**

* Understanding the Intelligence Community composition, including the roles and responsibilities of the IC components; methodologies inherent in Insider Threats; elicitation methods and procedures; counter\-elicitation methods and procedures; CI indicators of motivation; methods of information collection and information transmittal; the basics and methodologies employed in Competitive Intelligence and Economic Espionage practices; foreign intelligence/CI threat data and the agencies acquiring it (including general, site specific, and technical); implications to DARPA program efforts from various threats; and understanding, prioritizing, and counteracting threats.
* Attend meetings (either locally or out\-of\-area) and create meeting summaries or trip reports
* Prepare and submit meeting minutes on an as\-required basis
* Prepare/present briefings, incorporating graphics (if appropriate) for/to SID and DARPA leaders
* Prepare various security forms associated with their duties
* Assist in entry control and perform escort duties for visitors
* Answer telephones and other modes of administrative communications in the performance of duties
* Perform self\-inspections, identify security discrepancies, and report security incidents
* Perform, or support, security inspections, identify security discrepancies and prepare reports
* Perform courier duties within the continental United States (CONUS)
* Perform user\-level security administrator and information security responsibilities as required and in compliance with US Codes, Executive Orders, and DoD and DARPA policy
* Perform objective reviews on all documentation encountered during performance of duties
* Possess the energy, experience, and subject matter expertise to demonstrate sound judgment, foresight and problem\-solving skills in a fast\-paced S\&T RDT\&E environment
* Possess excellent organizational

jobs.title: Counterintelligence & Security Risk Analyst
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**



The Counterintelligence (CI) and Security Investigations Team's safeguards Anduril's workforce and supply chain by proactively identifying risk, mitigating threats and delivering actionable investigative insights*.*The team helps ensure our security environment remains vigilant and resilient so that our strategic interests are preserved. We are committed to anticipating and mitigating risks and threats enabling Anduril to innovate and operate confidently in a dynamic global environment.

  

### **ABOUT THE POSITION**



Anduril is seeking a professional to support the CI and Security Investigations team in a unique opportunity to help strategize, socialize and implement a CI and security risk program that requires significant critical thinking, creativity, complex problem solving and interpersonal skills, as well as the ability to work across a rapidly growing, global, dynamic organization to identify and mitigate threats. The Counterintelligence \& Security Risk Analyst Lead is responsible for analyzing threats from nation state actors and insiders affecting Anduril's workforce, technologies and supply chain globally. The role will involve the development and support of analytic efforts and work\-streams that integrate across key business processes and stakeholders, spanning people vetting, supplier and vendor risk, and enterprise CI analysis, to enable rapid mitigation and informed decision making. This position will leverage a variety of internal and external data sets and tools to develop a robust understanding of the threat environment. The Analyst must be a self\-starter that can operate independently and be responsive to fast paced and dynamic operational and threat environments, and must possess a deep understanding of CI, intelligence analysis, risk management, and a demonstrated ability to analyze and communicate complex risks and threats.

  

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Support the development of CI analysis tailored to the defense industry's unique threats and requirements, spanning workforce, technology and supply chain risk.
* Analyze threats from nation state actors, reviewing data from multiple sources to identify anomalous behaviors and other indicators.
* Execute workforce, visitor and supplier vetting initiatives, conducting thorough risk assessments and initial investigations to ensure Anduril is engaging with trusted people and vendors.
* Support a repeatable, scalable process for vetting of candidates, visitors, suppliers and vendors, and continuously monitor existing relationships for emerging risks.
* Coordinate with federal agencies, including the Department of Defense (DoD), Intelligence Community (IC), and Federal Law Enforcement, to access relevant threat information and stay current on evolving adversary tactics, techniques and procedures.
* Establish and leverage collaborative partnerships across internal stakeholders, including product, supply chain, legal, HR, and InfoSec teams, to identify data necessary to support robust research and analysis.
* Produce tailored and strategic risk assessments, detailed reports and presentations on findings, case studies, threat assessments, and recommended actions for multiple audiences to include senior leadership.
* Develop and implement analytic methodologies to assess counterintelligence, supplier and people related risks.
* Provide analytic support to investigations.
* Support the development of procedures, processes, risk frameworks and documentation that comply with government regulations and contractual obligations, and produce key metrics for leadership on a recurring basis.
* Monitor, analyze and communicate trends in people or supplier risk and nation state\-related risk and threats to help shape vetting and mitigation initiatives.
* Support the development of training and awareness materials and present tailored briefings to internal audiences.
* Travel as needed to support risk assessments at various Anduril site locations or external events.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Security or Intelligence Studies, Political Science, Criminal Justice, or a related field.
* 8 years of relevant work experience in CI analysis, intelligence operations or analysis, or people and supplier risk vetting, assessing complex threats from nation state actors and other nation state\-related risk.
* Experience conducting risk and threat assessments and presenting analysis to inform executive decision making.
* Demonstrated ability leveraging multiple data sets and tools to support complex research and analysis, as well as developing risk assessments and risk mitigation recommendations.
* Experience conducting public record research and investigations (e.g., criminal, civil, financial, corporate, property, licensing, or court records) in support of people and supplier vetting, or CI\-related assessments.
* Ability to synthesize public record findings with open\-source and other data sets to assess credibility, relevance, and risk, and communicate findings to technical and executive stakeholders.
* Experience with CI risk assessment methodologies and CI threat analysis.
* Experience leveraging critical thinking skills to creatively solve complex problem

Short\-term and long\-term disability options

Paid Time Off (PTO) and federal holidays for salaried employees
  

Access to wellness programs, discounts, and lifestyle benefits

jobs.description:
**OVERVIEW**


*A thriving, mission\-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award\-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide.*


*Across our organization, we're building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR**.* *This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.*

### **Application Deadline: Please submit your application by 5:00 pm EST on Friday, September 18th, 2026**


### **Intro to Position**



The Office of Transformation is responsible for leading the design and execution of enterprise\-wide transformation initiatives across NPR to support our ambitious goals for audience growth and enhanced Network collaboration. The Project Manager functions as the central operational coordinator within the Office of Transformation. Tasked with steering high\-priority initiatives, this role oversees complex transition timelines, coordinates deliverables between multiple independent teams, and ensures all project milestones are hit on schedule. This position requires a collaborative, detail\-driven leader who can seamlessly bridge operational gaps between technical, financial, and station relations functions.


### **Responsibilities**


* Timeline \& Milestone Enforcement: Design, monitor, and manage the master project roadmaps for critical Transformation initiatives, driving accountability across cross\-functional streams.
* Cross\-Functional Coordination: Act as the primary operational connector between the Office of Transformation and other NPR and NPM teams, for operational support on NPR's Transformation effort.
* Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify project dependencies, flag operational bottlenecks, and work with stakeholders to implement solutions to keep projects moving forward on time.
* Status Reporting \& Governance: Maintain real\-time status dashboards and reports, facilitate meetings, and package project updates for institutional leadership.
* Coordination Support: Assist the SVP of Transformation in coordinating projects and resources across NPR teams to further our Transformation goals.


**The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.**


### **Minimum Qualifications**


* 3\-5 years of dedicated professional project management experience steering enterprise\-level transitions or systems implementations.
* Demonstrated experience using advanced project management tracking methodologies, software, and dashboarding tools.
* Proven success directing cross\-departmental teams where deliverables depend on multiple matrixed stakeholders.

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Prior project management experience within a media organization, membership association, or non\-profit system.
* Familiarity tracking project timelines that intersect with CRM (Salesforce) database integrations or corporate compliance updates.

### **Required Skills/Competencies**


* Elite organizational, scheduling, and timeline management capabilities.
* Strong diplomatic and consensus\-building skills, with an ability to manage operational friction between technical and non\-technical staff.
* High level of agility with a track record of adapting project paths when unexpected data dependencies or legal constraints shift.

### **Education Requirements**


* Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.

### **Work Location \& Requirements**


* **NPR Remote\-Permitted**: This is a remote\-permitted role. This role is based out of our Washington, D.C. office, but the employee may choose to work on a remote basis from a location that NPR approves. You will have the option of working (a) remotely from a location of your choosing within the United States that is supported by NPR; (b) on\-site at an NPR facility, based on the availability of desks and approval from NPR; or (c) a combination of both. Regardless of where you choose to work from, you may be expected to travel to other locations from time to time to perform the duties of your position.

  


### **Job Type**


* This is a full\-time, exempt position.

**Salary Range**: The U.S.\-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $97,000\-$105,000 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

jobs.description:
Savvee Inc. is seeking a mission\-focused Program Manager to support our federal client onsite in Washington, DC. The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience leading complex federal programs that support IT governance, portfolio management, and strategic organizational initiatives within a CIO environment. This individual will excel at overseeing contract performance, resources, and financial operations while serving as a trusted advisor to senior government stakeholders and guiding multidisciplinary teams in delivering high\-quality program management support.


#### **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Serving as the dedicated Program Manager and primary point of contact between the Government (COR/CIO leadership) and the contractor team as well as meeting with the COR and CIO leadership on project management matters (staff introductions, meeting schedules, delivery dates).
* Planning, facilitating, and documenting the task order kickoff meeting (agenda and minutes) within 10 business days of award.
* Establishing and maintaining the team organization chart identifying the Program Manager and a task lead for each task area.
* Directing the task leads for each SOW task area Business Analyst, Senior (IT Portfolio Management), Project Task Manager (Program and Project Management Support), Communications Specialist (Strategic Portfolio Communications), and Technical Writer (Governance Documentation) and the Financial/Functional Analyst (IT financial management) and Enterprise Engineer (systems and platforms) subarea leads.
* Participating in regular project meetings called by the Government, vendors, and contractor partners to discuss status, specifications, work plans, schedules, and project issues.
* Preparing and submitting the monthly Accomplishments Report, which include assignments and work completed, personnel changes, project risks, milestones completed, and a lookahead of upcoming key activities, no later than 5 business days after the start of each month.
* Conducting presentations and briefings for various audiences as requested and overseeing quarterly, or asrequested, portfolio, program, and project briefings and reports providing expert recommendations and portfolio status.
* Overseeing delivery and quality of all task order deliverables (briefings/reports, meeting management and facilitation, communication management, expertise and support, documentation creation and management), ensuring completeness, accuracy, and timely delivery and correcting any rejected deliverable within three workdays or providing a corrective action plan.
* Providing program management, project coordination and integration, and governance support to federal and departmentwide IT initiatives throughout the IT solution lifecycle, including support to the client's IT audit and IT compliance programs.
* Producing program management analysis, status reports, dashboards, and maturity recommendations for key IT portfolio management programs and providing analysis and recommendations on implementation of IT governance policy, structure, and process.
* Supporting implementation of federal IT mandates (e.g., FITARA), providing input to responses to OMB and GAO requests, and leading support for the maturation of the client's portfolio and financial management office and its supportive programs.
* Managing contract resources, including staffing, onboarding, security processing, and personnel performance; respond to any Government qualityofservice notice within the twoweek performance improvement period and provide replacement personnel without a break in service.
* Managing task order financial performance, including tracking labor hours and cost against the firmfixedprice schedule, monitoring funding under the Limitation of Government's Obligation clause and notifying the Contracting Officer in writing before expenditures reach 85 percent of allotted funds, and reviewing monthly invoices for accuracy prior to submission.
* Ensuring all work is performed within the scope of the COR's written Technical Direction and notifying the CO in writing within three working days of any direction believed to exceed the task order scope.
* Ensuring contractor personnel identify themselves as contractor employees; report any actual or potential Organizational Conflict of Interest (OCI) to the CO immediately.
* Establishing and reporting performance standards that allow the Government to track cost, schedule, and plannedversusactual performance.
* Performing other duties as assigned by the COR.
* Performing additional duties as assigned in support of evolving contract requirements and client needs.
* Understanding the organizational policies and procedures for accuracy of solutions and deliverables to the client.
* Demonstrating a commitment to quality and customer support.

#### **REQUIRED EDUCATION AND TRAINING**

* Bachelor’s degree
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent

#### **MINIMUM EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS REQUIRED**

* Eight or more years of related experience leading and managing large scale IT programs
* Six or more years of proven experience managing a program
* Demonstrated expertise to manage and deliver all SOW task areas: IT portfolio management/CPIC support, IT strategic planning, enterprise IT risk management, IT financial management and governance, program/project management support, portfolio communications, and governance documentation
* Must have the ability to obtain the client’s suitability and meet federal background investigation requirements
* A proficiency in utilizing MS Office products
* Proven familiarity with Artificial Intelligence (AI) concepts and responsible use of AIassisted tools
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* A highly motivated selfstarter
* Must be motivated and have excellent customer service skills

#### **DESIRED BUT NOT REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Direct experience supporting federal CPIC processes, OMB IT Dashboard and Integrated Data

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist, U.S. Army
jobs.description:
**About Rivet**  

Rivet is an American company building integrated task systems — fusing hardened hardware with software, sensors, AI, and networking — for industrial workforces and defense personnel. We create capabilities that multiply the effectiveness of every individual and withstand the world’s toughest environments.  

  

We serve the people who build, operate, maintain, and defend our way of life. From technicians and engineers to first responders and service members, they embody the hard work, ingenuity, and meritocratic values that drive Western prosperity. Yet too often they are forced to rely on outdated tools that fail under modern pressures. Rivet exists to reset that priority.  

  

At Rivet, you’ll join a mission\-driven team that fuses disciplines to deliver decisive outcomes where they matter most. Whether shaping our technology, strengthening our partnerships, or building our culture, every role here contributes to equipping the front lines with the modern systems they deserve.  

  

**Work Authorization Requirement: Due to the nature of our business and compliance with federal regulations, all candidates must be a "U.S. Person". Upon hire, you will be required to provide documentation verifying your status as a U.S. Citizen, a lawful permanent resident, or a protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3\).**

**Summary**


The Deployment Strategist (DS) ensures the successful definition, implementation, and operations of new systems with Rivet customers. The DS guides customer and Rivet collaboration, aligning teams and deployment plans to meet mutual objectives.


The strategist is responsible for analyzing customer conditions, understanding data insights, and developing actionable plans to achieve desired outcomes. Additionally, the DS anticipates potential challenges, devising solutions to mitigate risks – or to achieve win/win competitive advantage.


As a relationship manager, the DS serves as a liaison between technical teams and customer stakeholders, facilitating clear understanding of project goals and progress. The strategist monitors deployment activities, provides regular updates, and ensures fidelity to agreed timelines and milestones. This role favors strong planning skills, acumen for technology breakthroughs with large customers, and a bias toward iterative action. At Rivet, the DS is uniquely positioned to create long\-term value with customers trusting us with their most strategic projects.


In addition to deployment execution, the DS plays a key role in shaping new business opportunities. This includes partnering with commercial and technical teams to scope prospective engagements, contribute to technical and programmatic proposals, and translate customer needs into compelling, executable plans. The DS ensures continuity between what is proposed and what is ultimately delivered.

**For the U.S. Army, the DS will identify, develop, and execute new opportunities across a broad range of mission areas, including combat, maintenance, logistics, sustainment, and other frontline operations. You will build relationships across Army organizations, understand operational challenges and emerging requirements, and translate those insights into opportunities for Rivet to deliver meaningful capability. This role requires the ability to move fluidly between strategic customer engagement and hands\-on execution, turning early conversations into pilots, programs, and long\-term partnerships across the Army.**

**Responsibilities**

* Identify and develop new opportunities across the U.S. Army, including combat, maintenance, logistics, sustainment, and other operational use cases
* Build and manage relationships with Army leaders, operators, program offices, acquisition stakeholders, and other key decision\-makers to understand mission needs and create demand for Rivet solutions
* Design and execute comprehensive plans to ensure the successful integration and deployment of Rivet systems within Army organizations
* Partner with commercial and engineering teams to translate Army needs into compelling technical approaches, proposals, deployment strategies, and executable plans
* Act as the customer voice, advocating for Army needs with Rivet engineering teams while identifying opportunities to expand the depth and scope of programs
* Own opportunities from initial customer engagement through pilot, deployment, and program expansion, ensuring continuity between what is proposed and what is ultimately delivered

**Requirements**

* 5\+ years of experience managing DoW / U.S. Army deployments of complex integrated technology solutions
* 5\+ years of experience owning technical solution sales, business development, or customer\-facing outcomes with government customers
* Demonstrated ability to identify customer problems and translate operational needs into executable technology solutions and business opportunities
* Experience contributing to or owning technical proposals, SOW development, capture efforts, or other complex government sales processes
* Exceptional customer development and communication skills, with the ability to build trust with senior military, technical, operational, and acquisition stakeholders
* Ability to travel 35\-70%; we are building sophisticated, controlled systems with hardware and software – you will be embedded with the team in office or at the customer point of need
* This position requires U.S. citizenship due to contract obligations; must hold an active U.S. security clearance and/or have the ability to be cleared


Compensation may vary within the posted range based on relevant experience, skills, education, and other job\-related factors. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for equity and other forms of compensation. Eligible employees also receive a competitive benefits package, including unlimited PTO.

AXON Networks is headquartered in Irvine, CA USA with Asia HQ in Singapore and also operating in Denmark, Spain and Vietnam.



The Operations Program Manager will be the central coordinator for scheduled operational activities affecting customers, production services and managed CPE fleets. You will maintain the authoritative global operations calendar and make sure every planned deployment, maintenance window, firmware rollout, migration, customer activity and operational event has the right scope, resources, dependencies, approvals, communications and execution plan.



Reporting to the Operations Manager and the Director of Network Operations, you will connect customer project managers and internal program managers with Support, NOC, DevOps, Engineering, QA, Product and other delivery teams. Your success is measured by predictable execution, early conflict detection, clear accountability and fewer customer\-impacting surprises; not by simply scheduling meetings or maintaining a project plan.



**Role mandate**
----------------



* Own the integrated schedule and coordination process for planned operational activities across regions, customers, services and technical teams.
* Maintain one authoritative global calendar that shows activity windows, customer commitments, resource assignments, dependencies, conflicts, risk and status.
* Drive each activity from intake through readiness, execution, validation, customer handoff and closure using clear milestones and accountable owners.
* Align Support, NOC, SRE, DevOps, Engineering and other required resources without taking over their technical decisions or people\-management responsibilities.
* Provide leaders, customers and delivery teams with timely, accurate visibility into the forward schedule, capacity constraints, risks, decisions and outcomes.
**What you will own**
---------------------


### **Global Operations Calendar \& Portfolio Control**


* Maintain the single authoritative calendar for all scheduled operational work across customers, regions, and time zones — capturing activity type, scope, risk tier, dependencies, owners, and readiness status.
* Identify and resolve scheduling collisions (shared resources, freeze periods, overlapping changes) before commitments are finalized.
* Publish forward\-looking views (24hr / 7\-day / 30\-day / quarterly) filterable by customer, region, service, and team.

### **Activity Intake, Planning \& Readiness**

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**



The Counterintelligence (CI) and Security Investigations Team's safeguards Anduril's workforce and supply chain by proactively identifying risk, mitigating threats and delivering actionable investigative insights*.*The team helps ensure our security environment remains vigilant and resilient so that our strategic interests are preserved. We are committed to anticipating and mitigating risks and threats enabling Anduril to innovate and operate confidently in a dynamic global environment.

  

### **ABOUT THE POSITION**



Anduril is seeking a professional to support the CI and Security Investigations team in a unique opportunity to help strategize, socialize and implement a CI and security risk program that requires significant critical thinking, creativity, complex problem solving and interpersonal skills, as well as the ability to work across a rapidly growing, global, dynamic organization to identify and mitigate threats. The Counterintelligence \& Security Risk Analyst Lead is responsible for analyzing threats from nation state actors and insiders affecting Anduril's workforce, technologies and supply chain globally. The role will involve the development and support of analytic efforts and work\-streams that integrate across key business processes and stakeholders, spanning people vetting, supplier and vendor risk, and enterprise CI analysis, to enable rapid mitigation and informed decision making. This position will leverage a variety of internal and external data sets and tools to develop a robust understanding of the threat environment. The Analyst must be a self\-starter that can operate independently and be responsive to fast paced and dynamic operational and threat environments, and must possess a deep understanding of CI, intelligence analysis, risk management, and a demonstrated ability to analyze and communicate complex risks and threats.

* Execute workforce, visitor and supplier vetting initiatives, conducting thorough risk assessments and initial investigations to ensure Anduril is engaging with trusted people and vendors.
* Support a repeatable, scalable process for vetting of candidates, visitors, suppliers and vendors, and continuously monitor existing relationships for emerging risks.
* Coordinate with federal agencies, including the Department of Defense (DoD), Intelligence Community (IC), and Federal Law Enforcement, to access relevant threat information and stay current on evolving adversary tactics, techniques and procedures.

* Develop and implement analytic methodologies to assess counterintelligence, supplier and people related risks.
* Provide analytic support to investigations.
* Support the development of procedures, processes, risk frameworks and documentation that comply with government regulations and contractual obligations, and produce key metrics for leadership on a recurring basis.
* Monitor, analyze and communicate trends in people or supplier risk and nation state\-related risk and threats to help shape vetting and mitigation initiatives.
* Support the development of training and awareness materials and present tailored briefings to internal audiences.
* Travel as needed to support risk assessments at various Anduril site locations or external events.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 8 years of relevant work experience in CI analysis, intelligence operations or analysis, or people and supplier risk vetting, assessing complex threats from nation state actors and other nation state\-related risk.
* Experience conducting risk and threat assessments and presenting analysis to inform executive decision making.
* Demonstrated ability leveraging multiple data sets and tools to support complex research and analysis, as well as developing risk assessments and risk mitigation recommendations.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist, Integration Partnerships
jobs.description:
**About Rivet**  

Rivet is an American company building integrated task systems — fusing hardened hardware with software, sensors, AI, and networking — for industrial workforces and defense personnel. We create capabilities that multiply the effectiveness of every individual and withstand the world’s toughest environments.  

  

We serve the people who build, operate, maintain, and defend our way of life. From technicians and engineers to first responders and service members, they embody the hard work, ingenuity, and meritocratic values that drive Western prosperity. Yet too often they are forced to rely on outdated tools that fail under modern pressures. Rivet exists to reset that priority.  

  

At Rivet, you’ll join a mission\-driven team that fuses disciplines to deliver decisive outcomes where they matter most. Whether shaping our technology, strengthening our partnerships, or building our culture, every role here contributes to equipping the front lines with the modern systems they deserve.  

  

**Work Authorization Requirement: Due to the nature of our business and compliance with federal regulations, all candidates must be a "U.S. Person". Upon hire, you will be required to provide documentation verifying your status as a U.S. Citizen, a lawful permanent resident, or a protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3\).**

**Summary**


The Deployment Strategist (DS) ensures the successful definition, implementation, and operations of new systems with Rivet customers. The DS guides customer and Rivet collaboration, aligning teams and deployment plans to meet mutual objectives.


The strategist is responsible for analyzing customer conditions, understanding data insights, and developing actionable plans to achieve desired outcomes. Additionally, the DS anticipates potential challenges, devising solutions to mitigate risks – or to achieve win/win competitive advantage.


As a relationship manager, the DS serves as a liaison between technical teams and customer stakeholders, facilitating clear understanding of project goals and progress. The strategist monitors deployment activities, provides regular updates, and ensures fidelity to agreed timelines and milestones. This role favors strong planning skills, acumen for technology breakthroughs with large customers, and a bias toward iterative action. At Rivet, the DS is uniquely positioned to create long\-term value with customers trusting us with their most strategic projects.


In addition to deployment execution, the DS plays a key role in shaping new business opportunities. This includes partnering with commercial and technical teams to scope prospective engagements, contribute to technical and programmatic proposals, and translate customer needs into compelling, executable plans. The DS ensures continuity between what is proposed and what is ultimately delivered.

**For this particular role, the DS, Integration Partnerships will build and manage a network of technology and industry partners that extends Rivet’s capabilities and accelerates customer outcomes. You will source and triage potential partners, evaluate their technology and strategic fit, develop relationships and integration opportunities, and manage partnerships from initial engagement through deployment and ongoing growth. This role requires strong technical judgment, commercial acumen, and the ability to identify where combining Rivet with complementary technologies can create differentiated solutions and unlock new customer opportunities.**

**Responsibilities**

* Source and develop relationships with technology and industry partners whose capabilities can complement Rivet’s products and create differentiated solutions for customers
* Triage and evaluate prospective partners based on technical capabilities, strategic fit, customer demand, integration complexity, and potential business value
* Work closely with Rivet engineering, product, and commercial teams to define integration opportunities, technical approaches, joint solutions, and paths to deployment
* Develop and manage partner relationships from initial engagement through integration, deployment, and ongoing expansion, serving as the primary point of coordination across organizations
* Identify opportunities to leverage partnerships to accelerate customer deployments, expand Rivet’s capabilities, and create new business opportunities
* Act as the internal and external owner for strategic partnerships, ensuring alignment on priorities, timelines, responsibilities, and mutual objectives

**Requirements**

* 5\+ years of experience in technology partnerships, business development, technical sales, product strategy, deployment, or a similar customer\- or partner\-facing role
* Demonstrated ability to source, evaluate, and develop strategic partnerships involving complex technology products or integrated solutions
* Strong technical aptitude and the ability to understand, evaluate, and communicate the capabilities and limitations of hardware and software technologies
* Experience working cross\-functionally with engineering, product, commercial, and customer teams to bring integrated solutions from concept to deployment
* Exceptional relationship\-building and communication skills, with the ability to establish trust and drive outcomes across senior technical, commercial, and operational stakeholders
* Ability to travel 35\-70%; we are building sophisticated, controlled systems with hardware and software – you will be embedded with the team in office or at the customer point of need
* This position requires U.S. citizenship due to contract obligations; must hold an active U.S. security clearance and/or have the ability to be cleared


Compensation may vary within the posted range based on relevant experience, skills, education, and other job\-related factors. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for equity and other forms of compensation. Eligible employees also receive a competitive benefits

jobs.title: Business Analyst 1 - Export & Parts Pricing Support
jobs.description:
**CLIENT HIGHLIGHT**The client you will be working for is a Top 20 Fortune Global 500 Consumer Electronics and Technology Company. This opportunity will give you experience in the technology sector in the United States with a company that is a globally recognized leader in smartphones, televisions, home appliances, and semiconductor innovation — and one of the most well\-known brands in the world.  

  

**LOCATION**Santa Ana, CA  

  

**COMPENSATION**$31\.70/hour  

  

**SCHEDULE**Fully on\-site, Monday\-Friday, 8am\-5pm.
Occasional extended hours may be required during peak export cycles or pricing update periods.  

  

**CONTRACT TERM**1\-year contract with a very high likelihood of extension/conversion to full\-time.  

  

**POSITION OVERVIEW**The Business Analyst I serves as a key operational and analytical support role within the organization, focusing on two primary functional areas: Export Order Management and Parts Pricing Management. This position plays a critical secondary support role requiring a high degree of organization, attention to detail, and strong interpersonal communication skills. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem\-solver who can manage multiple priorities, build cross\-functional relationships, and deliver accurate, timely reporting that supports business decisions.  

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**Export Specialist – Order Processing \& KPI Analysis:
* Process and manage export sales orders from initiation through final delivery, ensuring accuracy and compliance with export regulations and internal procedures.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for international subsidiary customers, maintaining professional and timely email communication to address inquiries, order status updates, and issue resolution.
* Coordinate logistics activities between freight forwarders, customers, and warehouse teams to ensure smooth order fulfillment and on\-time shipments.
* Monitor and track shipment milestones; proactively communicate delays or discrepancies to relevant stakeholders.
* Compile, analyze, and report on export Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), including order fulfillment rates, lead times, shipping accuracy, and customer satisfaction metrics.
* Maintain and organize export documentation, including shipping instructions, commercial invoices, packing lists, and any required compliance documents.
* Identify process gaps or recurring issues within the export workflow and recommend improvements to enhance efficiency.
* Support month\-end reporting related to export order volume, revenue, and performance trends.

Parts Pricing Management – CE \& MX Parts Support:
* Provide analytical and administrative support for pricing adjustments and updates for CE (Construction Equipment) and MX (Mexico) parts catalogs.
* Assist in reviewing, validating, and updating parts pricing data in applicable systems, ensuring accuracy and consistency.
* Coordinate with internal pricing, sales, and product teams to gather inputs needed for timely pricing updates.
* Support the preparation and distribution of pricing change communications to relevant stakeholders.
* Maintain organized records of pricing history, adjustment logs, and approval documentation.
* Assist in reconciling pricing discrepancies and escalating exceptions as needed.
Contribute to pricing performance reporting and analysis as directed.  
* 

  

**REQUIRED SKILLS \& COMPETENCIES*** Organization: Ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines, and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; professional email correspondence with international customers is essential.
* Follow\-Up: Strong sense of accountability; proactively follows up on open items to drive resolution.
* Documentation: Meticulous in maintaining accurate, complete, and well\-organized records.
* Data Analysis: Ability to gather, interpret, and present data in meaningful reports and dashboards.
* Collaboration: Works effectively with cross\-functional teams, including warehouse, logistics, sales, and finance.
Attention to Detail: High accuracy in data entry, order processing, and pricing updates.  
* 

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**Education:
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Finance, International Business, or a related field preferred.

Experience:
* 1\-2 years of experience in a business operations, logistics, supply chain, customer service, or related analytical role.
* Prior experience in export operations, international customer support, or parts/pricing administration is a plus.

Technical Skills:
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, data formatting).
* Experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or similar) preferred.
* Familiarity with order management or freight management platforms is a plus.
* Ability to create basic dashboards or reports in Excel or similar tools.

Language:
* English proficiency required (written communication skills are critical for international customer correspondence).
Bilingual (English/Korean) is a plus, given subsidiary interactions.  
* 

  

**PERFORMANCE METRICS*** Accuracy and timeliness of export order processing.
* Quality and responsiveness of customer and internal communications.
* On\-time coordination with freight forwarders and warehouse.
* KPI reporting completeness and delivery schedule adherence.
* Accuracy of parts pricing updates and documentation.

jobs.title: Budget Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job ID** REQ20179545 **Category** Accounting, Finance and Banking
  
The Department of Population and Public Health Sciences at the Keck School of Medicine of USC is seeking a Budget/Business Analyst to support the department's financial and administrative operations.


Employment involves **(1\)** administering, monitoring, reconciling, and forecasting departmental budgets; **(2\)** preparing financial reports, researching variances, and supporting purchasing and other financial transactions; **(3\)** coordinating position\-control documentation and serving as a liaison with Keck School of Medicine Human Resources (KSOM HR) throughout hiring and position\-extension processes; and **(4\)** assisting faculty and managers/supervisors with service agreements, supplier onboarding, and personnel allocation entries in Workday.


The Budget/Business Analyst will work closely with faculty, managers, supervisors, department leadership, KSOM HR, vendors, and other university offices. The position will help employees navigate university policies and processes, review documents for completeness and accuracy, track submissions through completion, troubleshoot issues, and maintain organized records. The analyst will also prepare ad hoc analyses and contribute to process improvements that strengthen the department's business, finance, and administrative operations.


The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail\-oriented, service\-minded, and able to manage multiple priorities independently in a deadline\-driven environment. Strong judgment, problem\-solving, follow\-through, written and verbal communication, and discretion with sensitive financial and personnel information are essential.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Administer assigned budgets; monitor income and expenditures; prepare projections; analyze trends and variances; and recommend or prepare budget adjustments in accordance with university guidelines.
* Reconcile account balances and activity to university financial records; initiate correcting entries; prepare accurate financial reports; and coordinate month\-end and year\-end activity.
* Support faculty and staff with purchasing, travel and expense activity, vendor transactions, and interpretation of university financial policies and procedures.
* Assist in coordination of the department's position\-control process, including assisting faculty and managers/supervisors with required forms and supporting documentation for new hires, position extensions, resource employees, and postdoctoral employees.
* Review position\-control submissions for completeness, accuracy, appropriate approvals, funding, and consistency; track status and follow up on outstanding items; and interface with KSOM HR to facilitate timely submission and resolution.
* Assist faculty and managers/supervisors with independent contractor agreements and professional services agreements, including coordination of required documentation and routing.
* Support supplier/vendor onboarding and serve as a liaison among requestors, suppliers, KSOM HR, and other university offices as needed.
* Enter and maintain personnel allocations in Workday, confirm funding details, and help resolve allocation\-related discrepancies.
* Prepare ad hoc financial and operational reports and contribute to process documentation and continuous improvement.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------


* At least one year of relevant budgeting, accounting, financial administration, or business operations experience.
* Demonstrated budgeting experience and knowledge of accounting principles and practices.
* Experience using Workday for financial, personnel, or related administrative transactions.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including the ability to organize, analyze, reconcile, and present financial data.
* Demonstrated accuracy, confidentiality, customer service, communication, and ability to manage multiple deadlines with limited supervision.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in business administration, accounting, finance, or a related field, or combined experience and education as a substitute for the minimum education requirement.
* Two or more years of related experience in a university, academic medical center, or similarly complex organization.
* University budget experience and knowledge of university financial and human resources systems.
* Experience supporting hiring or position\-control processes, service agreements, supplier onboarding, and personnel allocation entry.
* Experience working directly with faculty, managers, supervisors, human resources partners, and vendors.

The hourly rate range for this position is $37\.88 \- $41\.56\. When extending an offer of employment, the University of Southern California considers factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, federal, state, and local laws, contractual stipulations, grant funding, as well as external market and organizational considerations.

  

  

Minimum Education: Bachelor's degree Addtional Education Requirements Combined experience/education as substitute for minimum education Minimum Experience: 1 year Minimum Skills: Business administration, accounting or related degree and budget experience including knowledge of government and fund accounting. Strong computer skills with use of automated spreadsheets. Preferred Education: Bachelor's degree Preferred Experience: 2 years Preferred Skills: University budget experience and knowledge of university financial systems.
**Job ID** REQ20179545 **Posted Date** 09/04/2026

As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you will design and maintain reporting, dashboards, and self\-service analytics that enable data driven decision making across Viant's operations. * Collect, analyze, and interpret large datasets to develop clear, actionable insights and present findings through reports, dashboards, visualizations, and AI data agents
* Provide strategic recommendations based on data analysis and performance trends to improve campaign delivery and outcomes
* Design and maintain self\-service analytical tools that enable stakeholders to explore data and answer recurring business questions independently
* Support automated data processes and analytical workflows for ongoing operational and reporting needs
* Apply emerging AI capabilities to augment analysis and help surface insights or answer questions more efficiently
* Recommend and implement process improvements that enhance data quality, reporting efficiency, and alignment with business needs
* Maintain a high level of attention to detail to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of data and reporting outputs

* Professional experience with SQL and Google BigQuery, including the ability to write, optimize, and maintain complex queries
* Proficiency in Tableau with experience building scalable dashboards and self service reporting
* Experience working in Databricks or similar cloud based analytics platforms
* Experience in digital advertising, programmatic media, or marketing analytics environments
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate data into clear insights

Investing in our employee's professional growth is important to us, but so is investing in their well\-being. jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst, Paris
jobs.description:
**About Mirakl:**



Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.  

  

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI\-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).  

  

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450\+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third\-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.



For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.


**Mirakl in Numbers:**


* ️ Founded in 2012 \| Member of French Tech Next40
* 750\+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo


**Our Values:**



Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.



Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:


* **Work Hard Together:** Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
* **Get Things Done:** We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
* **Go Above \& Beyond:** We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
* **Succeed Through Expertise:** Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
* **Satisfy \& Empower Clients:** We're committed to our clients' success
**The Team You'll Join**
------------------------



You'll be part of our Revenue Operations team led by Julien Amoureaux, Team Lead, Revenue Operations. The team consists of 10 Revenue Operations Analysts working across all of Mirakl's suite of products. Together, you'll be driving the efficiency and scalability of Mirakl's sales cycle by ensuring systems, processes, and automation run seamlessly across the organization.

  


**Your Impact**
---------------


**Revenue Systems Support**


* Maintain and improve the tools supporting prospecting, sales execution, quoting, and revenue recognition across all of Mirakl's business units
* Administer Salesforce — managing users, permissions, workflows, approvals, and data quality — to keep the sales organization running smoothly
* Collaborate with RevOps Business Analysts to understand business needs and translate them into system or process improvements
* Partner with the RevOps Tech Lead on system architecture, integrations, data quality, and prioritization
* Document solutions, recurring issues, and standard operating procedures to build a reliable, scalable knowledge base for the team

  


**AI \& Automation**


* Design, deploy, and maintain AI\-agent processes and n8n workflows that automate recurring operational tasks across Revenue Operations
* Support business users and RevOps analysts in identifying automation opportunities and translating requirements into reliable, scalable solutions
* Monitor automated processes, troubleshoot failures, and continuously improve their performance and usability
* Contribute to building a robust automation framework with appropriate documentation, controls, and support processes

  


**CPQ Transformation**


* Support the rollout of Mirakl's new AI\-enabled CPQ operating model, coordinating requirements, testing, documentation, and rollout activities
* Work cross\-functionally with Sales, Finance, RevOps, and technical stakeholders to ensure new CPQ processes meet business needs
* Monitor the reliability and performance of CPQ processes post\-launch and drive continuous improvement
* Contribute to migrating from manual administrative maintenance toward more automated management of product, pricing, and approval rules

  


**What You'll Bring to the Role**
---------------------------------


**Experience:**


* 2\+ years of experience supporting business applications such as **Salesforce**, CPQ, CRM, sales engagement tools, or related Revenue Operations platforms
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex, cross\-functional projects with multiple stakeholders
* Hands\-on experience with or strong interest in AI agents, workflow automation, or tools such as n8n
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, or a related field — or equivalent experience

  


**Skills:**


* Analytical problem\-solving with strong attention to detail
* Ability to translate business requirements into system or automation solutions
* Clear communication and cross\-functional collaboration
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize multiple requests
* Adaptability and eagerness to learn in a fast\-moving environment

 **Tools Used**
--------------


* **CRM:** Salesforce
* **CPQ:** DealHub or equivalent CPQ platform
* **Automation:** n8n, Dust, AI agents
* **Data Managerment :** Databricks
* **Sales Engagement:** Prospecting and outbounding tools (e.g. Gong, Outreach)
* **Productivity \& Documentation:** Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, Confluence or Notion

**Languages**
-------------


* English: C2 (Full professional proficiency)
* French: C2 (Full professional proficiency)

**Our Hiring Process**
----------------------



We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.



Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.


* **Intro call with Talent Acquisition** — 30 minutes to explore your background, motivations, and answer any questions about Mirakl
* **Interview with Julien, the hiring manager** — A deep dive into your RevOps experience, technical background, and motivations
* **Values\-based interviews**

* Recueillir les besoins auprès des équipes métiers (commerce, marketing, finance, opérations) et les traduire en indicateurs et solutions data exploitables


* Réaliser des analyses de données permettant d'identifier les leviers d'action prioritaires et les axes d'amélioration pour les équipes métiers.


* Assurer un pilotage dans la durée des indicateurs clés (KPI), en suivant les écarts et en alertant les équipes métiers en cas de dérive


* Prendre en charge l'analyse des résultats d'enquêtes (volet Analytics), incluant l'automatisation des traitements et la systématisation de la diffusion des résultats aux responsables de secteur.


* Travailler en mode transverse avec des référents métiers en France et à l'international afin de comprendre leurs besoins et d'y répondre par des livrables adaptés à l'échelle Groupe.

**Profil et expérience**
------------------------


* Formation Bac\+4/5 (école de commerce, d'ingénieur ou université) avec une spécialisation Data / Business Analytics.


* Première expérience réussie (stage, alternance ou poste junior) sur des missions de data analyse ou de business intelligence.


* Anglais professionnel apprécié compte tenu des interactions avec des interlocuteurs internationaux



Vos compétences techniques :



* Maîtrise avancée de Power BI (modélisation de données, DAX, création de dashboards et administration)


* Maîtrise de SQL et des bases de données relationnelles pour l'extraction et la structuration de la donnée


* Bonne connaissance du CRM Microsoft Dynamics et des problématiques de qualité de données associées


* Capacité à automatiser des traitements de données récurrents (Python, Power Query) pour fiabiliser et accélérer la restitution



Votre savoir\-être et vos compétences transverses :



* Sens de l'analyse développé : capacité à transformer un volume de données complexe en constats clairs et actionnables.


* Rigueur, fiabilité et autonomie dans la conduite des sujets confiés.


* Posture professionnelle affirmée et orientation entreprise/résultats.


* Appétence marquée pour les sujets complexes, abordés avec curiosité intellectuelle et engagement.


* Capacité à évoluer dans des contextes transverses et internationaux, en lien avec des interlocuteurs multiples.

**À propos de nous**
--------------------


Elior, filiale d'Elior Group, est n°1 en restauration collective en France. Depuis plus de 25 ans, nous anticipons les évolutions de notre métier, en devançant les attentes et les besoins des enfants, élèves, étudiants, travailleurs, patients et résidents…



Rejoindre Elior France, c'est rejoindre 17 000 collaborateurs engagés sur l'un de nos 100 métiers, qu'il s'agisse de fonctions opérationnelles ou de fonctions support. Nos 3 500 restaurants sont répartis sur toute la France.  

Faire partie de nos équipes fonction support, c'est apporter votre soutien aux équipes opérationnelles pour les aider à satisfaire quotidiennement nos clients et convives. C'est également l'opportunité d'intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution qui vous permettra d'enrichir votre expertise et vos compétences.



Comme nous, venez exprimer votre passion de la cuisine et du service, et évoluer dans un Groupe qui favorise la réussite par le collectif et le collaboratif.
