jobs.title: Program Manager - Environmental Education & Community Engagement
jobs.description:
**Program Manager – Environmental Education \& Community Engagement**

**Painted Bins \& Resilient Neighborhoods \| Projects of Sustainable Marin**  
**Location:** Marin County, CA \| Hybrid  
**Salary:** $65,000 annually, plus benefits included below  
**Schedule:** Full\-time; occasional evening and weekend events

*Help Build a More Sustainable Marin*

Are you passionate about creating a more sustainable future? Painted Bins and Resilient Neighborhoods, projects of nonprofit Sustainable Marin, are seeking a collaborative, organized, and mission\-driven **Program Manager** to help educate, engage, and inspire Marin County residents to take meaningful climate action.

The **Program Manager** position offers the opportunity to work with both youth and adults, lead impactful environmental education and community engagement programs, and make a visible difference while working with a small, supportive team committed to innovation, collaboration, and lasting community impact.

**About Us**

**Painted Bins** empowers youth to become environmental stewards through environmental education, visual arts, and public speaking. Students turn what they learn into action, using their voices and creativity to inspire community\-wide behavior change. *www.paintedbins.org*

**Resilient Neighborhoods** empowers Marin County residents to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, prepare for climate\-related emergencies, and build stronger, more resilient communities through education and local action. *www.resilientneighborhoods.org*

Both organizations are projects of **Sustainable Marin**, a Marin County nonprofit organization. *www.SustainableMarin.org*

**The Opportunity**

As Program Manager, you will work closely with the leadership of Painted Bins and Resilient Neighborhoods to keep programs and projects organized, moving forward, and aligned with strategic priorities.

This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys managing multiple projects, working with a wide range of people, improving systems, and turning ideas into action. You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to two growing environmental programs and see the direct impact of your work throughout Marin County.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Manage multiple programs and projects from planning through implementation.

· Coordinate educational programs, community outreach, art shows, volunteer activities, and fundraising events.

· Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, workflows, and organizational systems using Monday.com and related platforms.

· Recruit, coordinate, and support volunteers.

· Build and maintain relationships with schools, community organizations, businesses, volunteers, and other partners.

· Track program outcomes, maintain databases, and analyze information to help measure impact.

· Identify opportunities to improve organizational systems and administrative processes.

· Support strategic initiatives that strengthen and expand environmental education and climate action programs.

· Balance priorities across two collaborative organizations while maintaining strong communication and attention to detail.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Required Qualifications**

· Bachelor’s degree.

· 2–5 years of experience in program management, project management, nonprofit administration, education, community engagement, or a related field.

· Excellent organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

· Strong written and verbal communication skills.

· Experience with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and online software platforms or databases.

· Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation for local meetings and events.

**Especially Helpful**

· Experience or interest in sustainability, climate action, environmental education, or community\-based programs.

· Experience working with schools, volunteers, community organizations, or nonprofit programs.

· Familiarity with Monday.com or similar project\-management platforms.

· A collaborative, flexible approach and enthusiasm for working in a small, mission\-driven organization.

· Spanish bilingual

**Position Requirements**

This is a hybrid position combining remote work with in\-person meetings, school and community activities, and events throughout Marin County. Occasional evening and weekend work and lifting of up to 30 pounds are required.

**Compensation**

**$65,000 annually, plus benefits to include paid time off and access to California retirement savings plan**

**How to Apply**

Please submit a **resume and cover letter to info.PaintedBins@gmail.com** describing your interest in the position and your experience in climate action and managing programs, projects, and/or community initiatives.

We are looking for someone who is excited to bring strong organizational skills, initiative, and a collaborative spirit to work that helps create a more sustainable and resilient Marin County.

Pay: $65,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Retirement plan

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Marin County, CA

jobs.title: Senior Operations Data Analyst
jobs.description:
### **Senior Operations Data Analyst**


**About the Company**



The mining industry has steadily become worse at finding new ore deposits, requiring \>10X more capital to make discoveries compared to 30 years ago. The easy\-to\-find, near\-surface deposits have largely been found, and the industry has chronically under\-invested in new exploration technology, relying on the manual techniques of yesteryear – even as demand accelerates for copper, lithium, and other metals to build electric vehicles, renewable energy, and data centers.



KoBold builds AI models for mineral exploration and deploys those models—alongside our novel sensors—to guide decisions on KoBold\-owned\-and\-operated exploration programs. Since founding in 2018, KoBold has become by far both the largest independent mineral exploration company and the largest exploration technology developer. Our data scientists and software engineers, who come from leading technology companies, jointly lead exploration programs with our renowned exploration geologists.



KoBold has proven its first discovery with materially less capital than the industry average and found one of the best copper deposits ever discovered: the copper is far more concentrated than the global average of copper mines, and this asset alone is expected to generate meaningful revenue for decades. KoBold has a portfolio of more than 80 other projects, each of which has the potential for another high\-quality discovery.



KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and natural resources companies Equinor, BHP, and Mitsubishi.

  


**About the Role**



Senior individual contributor reporting to the Head of Operations Data, coordinating day to day with the broader team and functional stakeholders. Owns systems end to end — data model, ETL, application, and stakeholder relationships — with minimal oversight from day one, and mentors junior analysts. Approximate initial allocation:


**Responsibilities**


* **45% Build \& integration** — new data models, ETL/API integrations, and app support (Foundry et al.)
* **25% Platform maintenance \& data quality** — OPSDB stewardship, sync reliability, alerting, production support
* **15% Governance \& technical debt** — RBAC, scoped roles, dbt semantic layer, documentation
* **15% Mingomba support \& cross\-functional mentorship** — commitments register, peer mentorship and skill growth, coordination with Mingomba functional growth like Procurement, Inventory


**Qualifications**


* 5\+ years in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data operations owning production systems independently
* Strong SQL and data modeling (PostgreSQL)
* Proven ETL and API integration
* Experience and comfort with AI (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.)
* Dbt, cloud tooling (AWS/S3\), finance\-systems (NetSuite/Tipalti), or geospatial data a plus.
* Intellectual curiosity and eagerness to learn about all aspects of mineral exploration, particularly in the geology domain. Enjoys constantly learning such that you are driving insights through using our tools in exploration and willing to work directly with geologists in the field.
* Ability to explain technical problems to and collaborate on solutions with domain experts who are not technical. A strong communicator who enjoys working with colleagues across the company.
* Excitement about joining a fast\-growing early\-stage company, comfort with a dynamic work environment, and eagerness to take on an evolving range of responsibilities.
* Keen not just to build cool technology, but to figure out what technical product to build to best achieve the business objectives of the company.
* A valid passport and willingness to travel to observe our work at Mingomba or at an exploration site around the world. Light travel is required when necessary.

  



KoBold Metals is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity for people of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, age, citizenship, disability, or veteran status.



This position is Full\-time Exempt



The US base salary range for this full\-time exempt position is $100,000 to $125,000 plus equity and benefits including 401k matching.



Location: KoBold is a remote\-first workplace. All candidates must be legally authorized to work in one of the following countries: United States or Canada.

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Front is the customer operations platform built for B2B complexity, keeping every team, tool, and customer conversation in sync so companies can scale without losing connection. Others handle simple interactions. Front handles the coordination and context behind complex B2B customer relationships. Over 9,000 companies, including Uber Freight, Navan, and Stripe, rely on Front because it's the only one that can run the operational layer that makes customer\-facing work actually succeed.


Backed by Sequoia Capital and Salesforce Ventures, Front has raised $204M from leading venture capital firms and independent investors including top executives at Atlassian, Okta, Qualtrics, Zoom, and PagerDuty. Front has received numerous Great Place to Work accolades, including **Top Places to Work by USA Today 2025**, **Y Combinator's list of Top Companies in 2023**, **\#4 on Fortune’s Best Workplaces in the Bay Area** ,**Inc. Magazine's 2022 Best Workplaces list**, and **Forbes Best Startup Employers 2022 List**.


We’re looking for a Senior Technical Project Manager / Senior Implementation Manager to join our Success Services team in the US. You will lead Front’s most complex customer implementations across net\-new onboarding, enterprise expansion, workflow transformation, migration, and adoption of new capabilities.


You will be the customer’s primary implementation partner and a senior advisor throughout the engagement. You’ll uncover business goals, translate complex processes into scalable Front workflows, establish the project operating model, lead change and enablement, navigate technical dependencies, and drive teams toward measurable value.


This is a hands\-on role for an experienced implementation leader. You will independently manage high\-stakes engagements while also improving how our team works through stronger playbooks, reusable solutions, coaching, and cross\-functional partnership.

**What will you be doing?**

* Own complex, multi\-workstream implementation engagements from discovery and solution design through launch, adoption, and value realization.
* Advise customer leaders on future\-state workflows, operating models, governance, and change—not simply configure stated requirements.
* Build and drive clear project plans, decision frameworks, stakeholder cadences, risk registers, and executive updates across multiple concurrent engagements.
* Lead discovery workshops that uncover business goals, process gaps, technical constraints, change risks, and measurable success criteria.
* Guide solution design involving permissions, integrations, data flows, automations, migrations, APIs, webhooks, and Front’s AI\-powered capabilities; independently handle common technical topics and engage specialists intentionally.
* Lead change management, enablement, cutover, and adoption strategies for teams moving from deeply embedded legacy tools and processes.
* Navigate escalations with calm judgment, clear ownership, and an ability to align customers and internal teams around trade\-offs and a path forward.
* Partner with Sales, Solutions, Account Management, Product, Engineering, and Support to define scope, resolve blockers, and improve the customer journey.
* Turn recurring customer needs into reusable implementation assets, playbooks, templates, and delivery improvements.
* Support team development through mentoring, thoughtful feedback, knowledge sharing, and leadership on strategic initiatives.
* Represent the customer voice and implementation perspective in product and operational decisions.

**What skills \& experience do you need?**

* 5\+ years of experience leading customer\-facing SaaS implementations, professional services engagements, technical programs, or similarly complex transformation work.
* A track record of independently owning complex implementations from discovery through sustained adoption, including multiple stakeholders, workstreams, and technical dependencies.
* Strong consultative and systems\-thinking skills; able to diagnose underlying business problems and recommend a practical future state rather than order\-take.
* Excellent project leadership, including scope, timeline, governance, risk, executive communication, and management of multiple concurrent priorities.
* Demonstrated change\-management experience, including stakeholder mapping, resistance management, enablement, cutover, and reinforcement after launch.
* Strong technical fluency across integrations, permissions, data flows, automations, migrations, APIs, and webhooks; able to learn products quickly and know when deeper expertise is needed.
* Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complexity, facilitate difficult decisions, and build trust across technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Sound judgment under pressure and experience recovering at\-risk projects or resolving escalations.
* Evidence of improving a services organization through reusable solutions, delivery methodology, enablement, mentoring, or operational improvements.
* Curiosity and practical judgment about AI and automation, including how to drive responsible customer adoption and improve personal effectiveness.

**What makes you a great fit?**

* You create clarity and momentum when the path is ambiguous.
* You challenge assumptions respectfully and make recommendations grounded in customer outcomes.
* You connect business strategy, workflow design, technical constraints, and change management.
* You communicate credibly with executives while staying close to execution details.
* You anticipate risks early, make trade\-offs explicit, and recover quickly when plans change.
* You measure success by adoption and value—not activity or go\-live alone.
* You improve the system around you and help teammates raise their craft.

**Front operates on a hybrid model — we come together in the office each Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday to collaborate and stay connected.**

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
At **Benchmark** , we are driven by our purpose: to innovate for a healthier, safer, and better\-connected world to create a brighter future. When you join us, you become part of a team passionate about making a meaningful impact across various sectors, including commercial aerospace, defense, advanced computing, next\-generation communications, complex industrials, medical, and semiconductor capital equipment. We prioritize career growth, fostering a culture that ensures you reach your full potential. At Benchmark, your work is purpose\-driven, enabling you to create a positive impact on the world and make your career truly meaningful. You’ll be part of a collaborative and inclusive team that values your ideas and contributions.  

  



**Summary:**  

The program manager is responsible for the execution of customer strategies related to one or more customers including all products/programs from new product introduction through volume production. He/she is responsible for achieving high customer satisfaction, driving profitable business relationships and sales growth and providing strong leadership to the customer focus teams to ensure achievement of customer commitments.


**Responsibilities:**  

* Leader of the customer focus team (CFT). Prioritize and monitors all CFT activities.
* Acts as primary day\-to\-day customer point of contact and functions as the primary Customer contact in resolution management and responsible for the overall health of the customer relationship.
* Ensures successful new product introduction:
* Executes to NPI standard process
* Understands and monitors S\&OP
* Identifies and secures skills needed for effective transitions
* Sets appropriate expectations with customers
* Manages pricing and ECO prioritization during the process
* Understands and maintains customer product knowledge and roadmap
* Gains understanding of customer market and competition
* Establishes and monitors KPI’s related to E\&O, PPV and inventory turns
* Manages recurring pricing activities. Uses contract, pricing model and updated costs to present new pricing to customers. Negotiates to successful completion.
* Monitors and investigates technical, scheduling, financial and quality metrics, which deviate from established requirements; determines cause, and, takes corrective action.
* Schedules Executive Business Reviews (EBR) and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR)

o Ensures appropriate attendees are well prepared for meeting, understanding data and issues
  

o Sets meeting objectives, develops agendas and tools to accomplish objective
  

o Prepares internal teams for meeting
  

o Aligns topics and presentations with customer prior to meeting
  

* Provides timely notification to GMs and global program managers of critical problems encountered, action taken, and anticipated effect on project objectives;
* Accountable for driving objectives related to continuous improvements
* Accountable to ensure the build and delivery schedules by working with the customer, internal supply chain, and operations.
* Works with SCA to ensure resolution of excess and obsolete inventory issues.
* Ensures the recovery for costs related to ECO activity, Non\-Recurring Expenses (NRE) and other miscellaneous.
* Meets and manages customer demand in accordance with contract, site inventory objectives, equipment and personnel capacity
* Ensures customer demand (PO and Forecast) is managed and well understood by CFT members
* Communicates updated data to close gap between customer request and Benchmark commitment (manage expectations)
* Tracks, trends and reports On\-Time Delivery to customer request and Benchmark commitment
* Monitors customer revenue plan through demand outlook
* Understands contractual obligations of the contract related to:

o Flexibility allowances and manages requests for pull\-ins and push\-outs or cancellations
  

o Payment terms and invoicing
  

o Any potential penalties from customer
  

o Cost reduction obligations/targets and communicates to organization
  

o Excess and obsolete terms, recovery and escalation path as required
  

o Warranty terms, recall and epidemic failure qualifiers
  

* Ensures execution to contract terms and conditions to meet Benchmark’s obligations.
* Communicates contract requirements internally.
* Conducts monthly Program Reviews utilizing Benchmark standard process.
* Executes customer quotation requests
* Assesses risk utilizing and the Risk/Liability Tool
* Ensures accuracy of quotations to protect gross margin
* Validates the establishment of quotes to actuals costs comparisons
* Coordinates with procurement organization to develop supply chain strategy which aligns with customer contract and site goals
* Identifies risk of inventory exposure, coordinates reserve with site controller
* Manages inventory days of sales
* Establish standard cost for parts based on customer’s influence, material, labor standard changes or inventory days
* Ensures Positive Price Variances alignment to site goals at the point of sale
* Reviews Supply Chain data related to component lead\-time, MOQ, and impacts to total inventory exposure
* Responsible to determine if customer will be responsible for negative PPV and or associated procurement costs and if so, collect money from customer
* Develops an understanding of DFx philosophy including Design for manufacturing, Design for Test, and Design for BOM or Cost and promotes with the customer and coordinates with the appropriate Benchmark function.
* Accountable for and ensures receipt and distribution of customer documentation packages.
* Coordinates collection and distribution of customer quality data.
* Ensures ECO process and impacts are captured and reported to customer.
* Monitors customer DPPM, DPU or DPMO with customer focus team to ensure quality measurements are within contract and customer required limits
* Monitors customer escapes events and lead customer focus team to root cause and corrective action driving clo

jobs.title: NPI Eng Program Manager, Amazon Devices Reverse Logistics
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Lab126 is an inventive research and development company that designs and engineers high\-profile consumer electronics. Lab126 began in 2004 as a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc., originally creating the best\-selling Kindle family of products. Since then, we have produced ground breaking devices like Fire tablets, Fire TV and Amazon Echo. What will you help us create?  

  

The Role:  

As a Engineering Program Manager within the Hardware Service Engineering team you are responsible for defining the customer facing and internal strategy for the warranty and returns services of a new complex product. In addition to creating the overall returns service strategy, the role owns development of technical processes for dis\-assembly, assembly, spare parts reclamation, and development of tooling solutions to facilitate service operations.  

  

This includes defining, developing, deploying and sustaining hardware screening operations and repair/refurbishment processes globally to support Amazon Digital Device products. The role will be expected to use program management experience to share the overall strategy, gain cross\-functional support, and hold stakeholders accountable to the overall Reverse Logistics NPI strategy.  

  

In this role, you will:  

1\. Conduct detailed technical review and assessment of hardware designs at different product development phases, and drive design\-for\-serviceability (DFS) decisions during product concept and architecture phases that ensure component accessibility, modular assembly, and repair\-friendly layouts to optimize serviceability outcomes.  

2\. Provide actionable, engineering\-driven feedback on hardware design features during product development with a focus on design\-for\-serviceability (DFS).
  

3\. Own the repair service cost\-model, making appropriate trade\-offs to optimize cost and quality  

4\. Own defining customer return screening and repair strategy for warranty and remorse returns  

5\. Design and develop customer return screening and repair processes that optimize cost and product recovery  

6\. Apply Design of Experiment (DOE) methods to design and launch repeatable and reliable repair processes  

7\. Own defining and delivering key end customer facing outputs including customer facing repair documentation, repair service offerings, and spare parts offerings.  

8\. Partner with suppliers and manufacturers to validate that tooling, test fixtures, and service solutions align with product support requirements, warranty cost targets, and product launch schedules.  

9\. Develop programs to reduce the need for new spare parts through refurbishment of previous used parts and for improvements on warranty costs  

10\. Develop repair processes for continued improvements on efficiency and reduced complexity in the operations  

11\. Travel Required up to 20% (Domestic and International)  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Assess risk to service and repair customer offerings for new products beginning at concept.
* Enable closed loop feedback to product design and product management.
* Identify opportunities to improve the design for serviceability, design for repairability and go to market (GTM) strategy for aftermarket support and pre\-owned sales of Amazon Devices.
* Measure cost of service and repair against financial targets.

  

A day in the life  

As the overall owner of the NPI process within Reverse Logistics, on a daily basis, you will work with a broad cross\-functional team responsible for launching some of our most complex products. Your day will likely begin with updates from the European and Asian stakeholders for product launch. Then you will focus on documenting the plan of record for service and repair, with special focus on identifying serviceability and repairability improvement opportunities to reduce overall service and repair costs. Using your knowledge of repair processes you will submit requests for design changes to product design. To end your day you will work with product management, customer service, and SW tech teams to scope new customer facing service offerings required for the new Amazon product.
  

  

About the team  

Amazon Devices Reverse Logistics owns global warranty and services for all Amazon Device products. The team's vision is to power the circular economy by giving consumer electronic products another chance to be loved.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of customer\-facing product development and product management, including defining, launching, and optimizing product and services experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience leading cross\-functional teams to deliver products and online services on tight deadlines
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience working with Data \& AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage
* Experience in Reverse Logistics, Service Engineering, Product Design or Manufacturing Tooling and Process Development.

jobs.title: Local Defender - Cybersecurity (SOC Analyst & Threat Analyst)
jobs.description:
The Local Defender is a critical cybersecurity role responsible for protecting the organization's digital assets through proactive monitoring, analysis, and response to cyber threats. This role combines the duties of a Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst and Threat Analyst to ensure an holistic defense against emerging threats. Key responsibilities include monitoring security logs, analyzing and reporting cyber incidents, reviewing Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs), and implementing directives from NETCOM (e.g., Cyber Tasking Orders – CTO). Work is performed on\-site with occasional on\-call duties for critical incidents in a collaborative, demanding environment requiring attention to emerging threats and vulnerabilities.



The preferred candidate will be well\-versed in common cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and adversarial tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs). In this role, the candidate is expected to work with minimal guidance, in a cross\-functional team, ensuring reports and recommendations are effectively communicated and actioned to support the Government customer and mission requirements.


**Principal Duties and Responsibilities (Essential functions):**

* Monitor and analyze security events and alerts generated by SIEM platforms, firewalls, IDS/IPS, and endpoint detection tools to identify potential threats and anomalous behavior.
* Perform basic system administration functions on the sensor capability systems and components, such as applying patches and updates if touch labor is required.
* Analyze data from installed OT sensors to identify patterns and trends and assist with the reports generated regarding system performance and health.
* Diagnose and resolve issues related to sensor data, including malfunctioning sensors, communication problems, and data integrity problems if necessary.
* Analyze potential security incidents and investigate to determine the scope, impact, root cause, and recommend effective remediation strategies.
* Perform triage on security incidents to identify root causes and recommend appropriate mitigation measures.
* Conduct regular reviews of SIEM reports to identify patterns, trends, and potential vulnerabilities within the organization's infrastructure.
* Develop actionable recommendations based on SIEM data analysis to enhance detection capabilities, optimize alert configurations, and address identified gaps.
* Escalate critical incidents to senior leadership or appropriate teams and provide detailed incident summaries with proposed mitigation actions.
* Maintain accurate documentation of security events and incident\-handling procedures.
* Monitor and evaluate Cyber Tasking Orders (CTOs) and other directives from NETCOM, ensuring compliance and timely implementation of mitigations.
* Conduct research on the latest organization’s environment threat vectors, attack methodologies, and adversarial tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
* Collaborate with other cybersecurity team members and the government customer to integrate threat intelligence into incident detection and response processes.
* Analyze CVEs, security bulletins, threat intelligence feeds, and security advisories to assess their relevance and potential impact to the mission and the organization’s environment.
* Correlate threat intelligence with SIEM findings to identify and assess emerging threats.
* Develop and communicate proactive mitigation strategies based on threat landscape trends and adversary tactics.
* Generate detailed and actionable reports for leadership from SIEM platforms summarizing identified threats, incidents, and remediation steps.
* Provide recommendations for improving the organization’s cybersecurity posture based on incident trends and threat intelligence.
* Maintain clear communication with cross\-functional teams to ensure alignment with security objectives and protocols.
* Generate detailed reports on threats, false positives, and actionable insights.
* Provide the Government customer and leadership with concise, data\-driven recommendations for enhancing the organization’s cybersecurity defenses based on SIEM trends and incident analysis.
* Prepare summaries and status updates of security posture improvements resulting from SIEM data analysis and implemented recommendations.
* Support the configuration, tuning, and optimization of security monitoring tools, including SIEM and threat detection platforms.
* Work with the team to improve the accuracy, reliability, and efficiency of OT sensor data collection and analysis.
* Conduct periodic reviews and updates of security tools to address gaps or inefficiencies.
* Participate in the testing and implementation of new security technologies as required.
* Collaborate with the team and the stakeholder community to fine\-tune SIEM configurations, including custom rule creation and log source integration, to improve threat detection accuracy.
* Conduct periodic evaluations of SIEM and related tools, providing recommendations for feature enhancements or additional capabilities.
* Support the testing and deployment of security solutions to ensure seamless integration with the existing monitoring infrastructure.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist, Integration Partnerships
jobs.description:
**About Rivet**  

Rivet is an American company building integrated task systems — fusing hardened hardware with software, sensors, AI, and networking — for industrial workforces and defense personnel. We create capabilities that multiply the effectiveness of every individual and withstand the world’s toughest environments.  

  

We serve the people who build, operate, maintain, and defend our way of life. From technicians and engineers to first responders and service members, they embody the hard work, ingenuity, and meritocratic values that drive Western prosperity. Yet too often they are forced to rely on outdated tools that fail under modern pressures. Rivet exists to reset that priority.  

  

At Rivet, you’ll join a mission\-driven team that fuses disciplines to deliver decisive outcomes where they matter most. Whether shaping our technology, strengthening our partnerships, or building our culture, every role here contributes to equipping the front lines with the modern systems they deserve.  

  

**Work Authorization Requirement: Due to the nature of our business and compliance with federal regulations, all candidates must be a "U.S. Person". Upon hire, you will be required to provide documentation verifying your status as a U.S. Citizen, a lawful permanent resident, or a protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3\).**

**Summary**


The Deployment Strategist (DS) ensures the successful definition, implementation, and operations of new systems with Rivet customers. The DS guides customer and Rivet collaboration, aligning teams and deployment plans to meet mutual objectives.


The strategist is responsible for analyzing customer conditions, understanding data insights, and developing actionable plans to achieve desired outcomes. Additionally, the DS anticipates potential challenges, devising solutions to mitigate risks – or to achieve win/win competitive advantage.


As a relationship manager, the DS serves as a liaison between technical teams and customer stakeholders, facilitating clear understanding of project goals and progress. The strategist monitors deployment activities, provides regular updates, and ensures fidelity to agreed timelines and milestones. This role favors strong planning skills, acumen for technology breakthroughs with large customers, and a bias toward iterative action. At Rivet, the DS is uniquely positioned to create long\-term value with customers trusting us with their most strategic projects.


In addition to deployment execution, the DS plays a key role in shaping new business opportunities. This includes partnering with commercial and technical teams to scope prospective engagements, contribute to technical and programmatic proposals, and translate customer needs into compelling, executable plans. The DS ensures continuity between what is proposed and what is ultimately delivered.

**For this particular role, the DS, Integration Partnerships will build and manage a network of technology and industry partners that extends Rivet’s capabilities and accelerates customer outcomes. You will source and triage potential partners, evaluate their technology and strategic fit, develop relationships and integration opportunities, and manage partnerships from initial engagement through deployment and ongoing growth. This role requires strong technical judgment, commercial acumen, and the ability to identify where combining Rivet with complementary technologies can create differentiated solutions and unlock new customer opportunities.**

**Responsibilities**

* Source and develop relationships with technology and industry partners whose capabilities can complement Rivet’s products and create differentiated solutions for customers
* Triage and evaluate prospective partners based on technical capabilities, strategic fit, customer demand, integration complexity, and potential business value
* Work closely with Rivet engineering, product, and commercial teams to define integration opportunities, technical approaches, joint solutions, and paths to deployment
* Develop and manage partner relationships from initial engagement through integration, deployment, and ongoing expansion, serving as the primary point of coordination across organizations
* Identify opportunities to leverage partnerships to accelerate customer deployments, expand Rivet’s capabilities, and create new business opportunities
* Act as the internal and external owner for strategic partnerships, ensuring alignment on priorities, timelines, responsibilities, and mutual objectives

**Requirements**

* 5\+ years of experience in technology partnerships, business development, technical sales, product strategy, deployment, or a similar customer\- or partner\-facing role
* Demonstrated ability to source, evaluate, and develop strategic partnerships involving complex technology products or integrated solutions
* Strong technical aptitude and the ability to understand, evaluate, and communicate the capabilities and limitations of hardware and software technologies

**Location:** Oakland, CA

**Account Manager Notes:**  

**MSP Notes:**

**Job Description:**  

**Department Overview**  

The Strategy and Innovation (S\&I) team is focused on enabling an electrified, clean\-energy 2040 with affordable rates for our customers through innovation and partnerships that deliver transformative, scalable solutions to interlocking utility challenges; electrification of vehicles and buildings to achieve beneficial electric load growth that delights customers; and electric load management solutions to support load growth while mitigating infrastructure and procurement spend.  

  

**Position Summary**  

The Business Data Analyst is responsible for advancing the assessment and valuation of flexible load resource opportunities and integrating them into transmission, distribution, and energy procurement planning and operations processes to unlock new flexible capacity and delay, or eliminate, the need to expand existing infrastructure, construct new power lines, or procure additional energy supply. The successful candidate will work closely with professionals in utility planning and engineering organizations, solutions design, and load management strategy to provide insights on the optimal placement and orchestration of distributed energy resources (DERs), as well as how to incorporate, evaluate, and scale the use of flexible load resources in planning processes and operations.  

  

**Job Responsibilities**  

Strategy
* Identify opportunities to develop criteria and methodologies for incorporating flexible load resources into planning scenarios by working with planners to identify areas with overloads, reliability issues, and operational risks.
* Connect with experts to understand available data sources and develop strategies that support the efficient management and application of that data to inform key decision\-making.
* Support the development of executive and board\-level materials by synthesizing analytical findings, insights, and recommendations for key stakeholders and decision makers.
* Support regulatory strategy, proceedings, stakeholder engagement, and DER valuation discussions with the CPUC, CEC, California Independent System Operator (CAISO) and other stakeholders.

Analysis
* Leverage research and analysis to provide insights to planning and operations professionals on cost\-effective ways to use flexible load resources to solve grid constraints.
* Design and execute field studies and planning analyses to validate the firmness, duration, and magnitude of load relief, rate impacts, and financial outcomes delivered by DERs.
* Develop an inventory of technical requirements to inform future load management program design and regulatory filings aligned with
* Support the development, enhancement, and application of analytical tools, including complex techno\-economic modeling, forecasting, data analysis, and program evaluation, to help inform internal load management and DER strategy.
* Gather, evaluate, and manage market, financial, regulatory, and other relevant industry data to support DER valuation and cost\-effectiveness analyses.
* Develop dashboards, visualizations, and executive\-ready materials that translate complex technical and financial analyses into actionable recommendations.

Project and Change Management
* Serve as a liaison between the LMS\&P and Transmission and Distribution planning teams to integrate learnings into planning, procurement, and business processes to leverage flexible resources at scale.
* Conduct benchmarking studies and use relevant industry data to support program and strategy development. Serve as the point person for cross\-utility benchmarking and industry initiatives.
* Collaborate with valuation and strategy leads to develop and apply DER valuation methodologies, including project planning, tool deployment, progress tracking, and stakeholder communications.
* Coordinate with internal teams, external vendors, aggregators, and industry partners to evaluate flexible load capabilities, data requirements, and implementation pathways.
* Partner with program and customer\-facing teams to ensure flexible load solutions are technically viable, cost\-effective, scalable, and aligned with customer needs.

**The successful candidate is expected to have technical, analytical, and power systems skills to structure analysis, process data, and at times run system studies. In addition, the ideal candidate will be an organized self\-starter who is action\-oriented, able to operate with general direction, and able to navigate ambiguity and independently move concepts from strategy to execution, while being mindful and sensitive to building trust, consensus, and buy\-in across the organization. This execution\-oriented candidate will collaborate with PG\&E subject matter experts, leaders, and partners across the organization, as well as other utilities, industry partners, and vendors.**  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

A strong applicant will be organized and motivated, with a demonstrated track record of building consensus and managing many moving parts within matrixed teams.
* Bachelor's degree in data science, computer science, engineering or equivalent experience.
* 5 years of related experience or equivalent.
* Experience with programming and scripting languages, such as Python and SQL.
* Experience with data warehousing, data quality, and ETL techniques.
* Experience with data processing tools such as Excel, SharePoint, and Microsoft Lists.
* Experience with financial and techno\-economic modeling.

**Desired Qualifications**
* Degree or advanced coursework in data science, engineering, economics, energy system

jobs.title: Pricing Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
* Sunnyvale, CA, United States
* Not Remote
* Finance \& Accounting
* JOB218596


  
### **Company Description**


It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.


We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.


The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.


If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.


### **Job Description**


**Primary Function of Position:**


We are seeking a process\-oriented Pricing Operations Analyst to support how pricing reaches the customer: the global price books that carry it, the contracted pricing that governs it, and the Configure Price Quote (CPQ) system that executes it.


Pricing operations is where commercial strategy becomes real. This role designs the processes and system logic that make quoting accurate, fast, and simple for the sales teams and customers who depend on it, and serves as the practical expert on what can be delivered within existing system constraints: what is achievable, in what sequence, and at what operational cost.


Partnering with regional pricing, Sales Operations, Contracts, Customer Service, Product Management, and Systems teams, the Analyst will create excellence in the transaction experience, quoting process, and pricing fidelity across the quote\-to\-cash continuum. Success in this role is measured less by analysis produced than by how reliably price is executed worldwide.


**Roles \& Responsibilities:**


**Price Book Management**


* Support creation and maintenance of global price books, including new product introductions, list price changes, regional variants, effective dating, and ongoing accuracy.
* Drive the pricing release calendar, coordinating change windows with commercial, regional, and systems stakeholders.

**Contract\-Based Pricing**


* Activate and maintain contracted, deviated, and tiered customer pricing in CPQ and ERP, including GPO and IDN agreement terms, membership eligibility, and price expiration tracking.
* Research and resolve price discrepancies across quote, order, and invoice, correcting the underlying system condition rather than the individual transaction.
* Support the discount approval process for local commercial leader price decisions.

**Systems and Configuration**


* Configure and maintain CPQ pricing logic, discounting rules, and approval workflows.
* Perform regression testing of pricing logic following each system change or price book release.
* Partner with Systems and IT on CPQ build, enhancement scoping, and defect resolution.

**Process Design and Optimization**


* Design, document, and improve repeatable price execution processes, removing friction across the quote\-to\-cash continuum.
* Evaluate trade\-offs between process change and system change, and recommend the approach that delivers the outcome soonest at acceptable operational cost.

**Enablement and Customer Experience**


* Train and enable sales, sales operations, and regional pricing teams on quoting and price execution, acting as the first point of contact for how\-to questions.
* Improve the quoting and purchasing experience for sales teams and customers, treating both as the customer of this function.

**Controls and Reporting**


* Maintain controls and audit\-ready documentation for all price book and contract pricing changes.
* Report on price execution accuracy and quoting cycle time, and act on the trends that surface.

### **Qualifications**


**Required Skills and Experience:**


* Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in pricing operations, sales operations, order management, contract administration, or business process roles, including a minimum of 2 years of hands\-on CPQ configuration.
* Hands\-on configuration experience with a CPQ platform, including pricing rules and approval workflows.
* Direct experience administering contracted or deviated customer pricing.
* Demonstrated process design and process mapping capability, with clear written documentation.
* Attention to detail and accuracy when working with high\-volume pricing data.
* Ability to identify workable solutions inside a fixed system, and to explain trade\-offs between process change and system change to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Service orientation toward internal partners and external customers.
* Advanced Excel skills, with working knowledge of Tableau.
* Strong collaborator across time zones and functions, with a focus on process integration and optimization.
* This role requires approximately 10% travel, including international travel.
* This role requires working onsite in our Sunnyvale, CA office Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday every week.

**Required Education and Training**


* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Operations, or a related field

**Preferred Skills and Experience**


* Background in or familiarity with the healthcare industry, medical devices, and hospital operations.
* Familiarity with GPO and IDN contract structures and healthcare contract administration.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP or a comparable ERP system, and ownership of price books or comparable master data.
* Experience applying generative AI tools to process automation and documentation.

Overview:
**Company Summary**
Intren West (IW) Professional Services Construction Management Solutions provides strategic program management, construction management, and operational consulting services supporting complex infrastructure, utility, and capital improvement initiatives. The company specializes in delivering high\-impact solutions across planning, execution, field operations, stakeholder coordination, and regulatory compliance for public and private sector clients.  

With expertise in utility operations, infrastructure modernization, wildfire resilience, climate adaptation, and operational strategy, IW Professional Services partners with organizations to improve project delivery, operational efficiency, safety, and long\-term asset performance. The firm supports cross\-functional program execution through disciplined governance, technical oversight, risk management, and data\-driven decision\-making.  

IW Professional Services is committed to delivering scalable, sustainable, and cost\-effective solutions that help clients navigate evolving operational challenges while advancing reliability, resiliency, and customer\-focused outcomes.  

The Business Analyst is responsible for analyzing moderately complex business data, identifying trends and insights, and supporting data\-driven decision\-making across the organization. This role partners with stakeholders to understand business needs, collect and evaluate data, develop reports and dashboards, conduct research, and present findings to various audiences. The analyst applies qualitative and quantitative analytical techniques, performs what\-if modeling, tracks key performance indicators (KPIs), and contributes to project teams that drive operational and strategic improvements.

  

The ideal candidate possesses strong organizational and multitasking abilities, can effectively adapt to changing business priorities and ambiguity, and demonstrates excellent presentation and communication skills. Success in this role requires proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and related project management and process\-mapping tools such as Project or Visio, along with a solid understanding of market research, project management practices, and business performance metrics.

 **Top Things Looking For:**

* Qualitative and quantitative analytical skills
* Organizational, prioritization and multi\- tasking skills.
* Adaptable to changing business conditions and ambiguity
* Presentation skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Project, Visio, or similar software

 **JOB TITLE:** Business Analyst

**LOCATION:** Hybrid – Oakland, CA (OPEN TO NON\-LOCAL CANDIDATES BUT PREFER LOCAL AND RESIDING IN THE BAY AREA)

**HOURLY RANGE: $38\.32 \- $57\.45**
Responsibilities:
* Performs analysis on moderately complex data models selecting from various reports and data options.
* Determines data needs, collects data, selects from different analytical techniques to achieve desired data outcomes.
* Understands business needs, develops new reports and performs custom/ad\-hoc reporting working independently. Presents findings to various audiences.
* Performs basic research internally and externally.
* Communicates with peers inside and outside the department exchanging ideas or gathering information.
* Participates on project teams.


Qualifications:
**Education**

* Bachelor of Science in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering or related discipline or equivalent work experience required.

**Experience**

* 2 years of related work experience

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (Desired)**

* Knowledge of different analytical methods, approaches and tactics
* Full understanding of fundamental analysis and what\-if modeling and how different factors affect business outcomes
* Qualitative and quantitative analytical skills
* Organizational, prioritization and multi\- tasking skills.
* Adaptable to changing business conditions and ambiguity
* Presentation skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Project, Visio or similar software

**Technical Competencies**

* Advanced in Information Analysis, Metrics and KPI Tracking
* Proficient in Market Research, Consulting Skills, Project Management Skills
* General understanding in Operational Monitoring \& Analysis, Advocacy and Persuasion, and Presentation Skills

* Travel may be required

 **HOURLY RANGE: $38\.32 \- $57\.45** **Benefits:**
Full\-time employees are eligible to participate in our benefit plan which includes the following:* 401(k) Plan
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Health, Dental, \& Vision Insurance
* Voluntary Life Insurance
* Voluntary Short Term \& Long\-Term Disability
* Paid time off

This organization is focused on delivering unparalleled value to our customers through frictionless embedded payments and commerce solutions at scale. You will play a key role delivering projects to drive scalable growth across the EverCommerce Solution Organizations. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast\-paced environments, takes extreme ownership of complex initiatives, and confidently drives cross\-functional teams toward successful delivery. You will lead high\-visibility payment initiatives spanning product, engineering, operations, customer success, and executive leadership while ensuring projects remain on track and stakeholders remain accountable.


**Responsibilities:**


* Serve as the single point of accountability for multiple strategic payment initiatives from initiation through successful delivery.
* Drive accountability with cross\-functional teams, ensuring commitments are met regardless of organizational level or reporting structure.
* Identify project risks early, proactively remove blockers, and escalate issues with mitigation plans and recommended solutions.
* Lead executive\-level status meetings with confidence, providing concise updates, clear decisions, and actionable next steps.
* Maintain complete ownership of project plans, dependencies, risks, decisions, and action items.
* Build scalable project governance through clear plans, transparent reporting, proactive risk management, and actionable executive communications.
* Build and maintain positive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Lead project retrospectives to identify areas for improvement and implement changes as necessary.

* Minimum of 5\+ years of experience in project management

* Advanced proficiency with Asana is required. Candidate should have experience building project plans, managing dependencies, dashboards, reporting, automations, portfolios, and executive reporting

new_jobs.title: Math, Accounting, Computer Science, Data Analyst Background Wanted — $80,000/Year
new_jobs.description:
Are you extremely good with numbers?

Do you enjoy spreadsheets, analyzing information, solving problems, and figuring out the most efficient way to accomplish something?

**Royal Maintenance Group** is a fast\-growing national contracting and property services company operating across **27 states**, and we're looking for a highly analytical person to join our team.

**You** **do not need previous estimating or industry experience**.

We are specifically interested in candidates with backgrounds or strong interests in areas such as:

* Mathematics
* Accounting
* Finance
* Computer Science
* Engineering
* Economics
* Data Analytics
* Business Analytics

What Will You Actually Be Doing?

Your job will be to help us figure out **what projects should cost**.

Our company manages large commercial projects throughout the country. Before we can price a project for a customer, someone needs to analyze the property, determine what resources will be required, calculate costs, and make sure the project can be completed profitably.

That's where you come in.

You will analyze information such as:

* Property sizes and measurements
* Labor requirements
* Material costs
* Equipment requirements
* Vendor and subcontractor pricing
* Maps and property layouts
* Historical project data
* Project specifications
* Profit margins
* Customer requirements

You'll then use that information to build accurate estimates and pricing models.

Think of the position as a combination of **math, business analysis, problem solving, and project strategy.**

**What We're Looking For:**

We care much more about **how you think** than whether you've worked in our industry before.

**You may be a great fit if:**

* You're naturally good with numbers
* You're extremely detail\-oriented
* You enjoy solving complicated problems
* You're very comfortable using computers
* You're strong with Excel or spreadsheets
* You can look at a lot of information and make sense of it
* You notice details other people miss
* You learn new systems quickly
* You're organized
* You're comfortable making decisions
* You take ownership of your work
* You're ambitious and want to grow

**Previous estimating or construction experience is NOT required.**

We will teach you our industries and how our projects work.

We're looking for someone who can bring the **analytical ability**.

The Projects

You'll work on pricing projects for major commercial properties throughout the United States.

Depending on the season and division, projects may involve:

* Snow and ice management
* Commercial roofing
* Property maintenance
* Facility services
* Other commercial contracting services

One day you might be analyzing the cost to service a portfolio of commercial properties during a snowstorm.

Another day you might be speaking with subcontractors executing the operations.

The industries change.

**The underlying job is the same: analyze the project, understand the numbers, and determine what it should cost.**

Compensation

**$80,000 per year**

Full\-time position.

**Monday through Friday**  
**8:00 AM – 4:00 PM**

Hoboken Office

**1 Newark Street**  
**Hoboken, NJ 07030**

Our office is located just steps from the **Hoboken PATH station**, making it extremely convenient from Manhattan and throughout North Jersey.

Free parking is also available at a nearby parking garage.

No Industry Experience? That's Okay.

We're not necessarily looking for someone who already knows our business.

We're looking for someone who is **smart, analytical, curious, and capable of learning it.**

You'll get exposure to how a large national company prices projects, evaluates profitability, manages vendors, makes operational decisions, and grows into new markets.

**Career Growth**

We're looking for someone who can eventually become much more than an entry\-level analyst.

As you learn the business and demonstrate your abilities, there may be opportunities to advance into:

* Senior Estimating
* Business Analytics
* Pricing Strategy
* Project Management
* Operations
* Division Management
* Senior Management

Royal Maintenance Group is continuing to expand, and we want ambitious people who are interested in growing alongside the company.

If you're highly analytical, great with numbers, and looking for something more entrepreneurial and hands\-on than a traditional accounting or corporate analyst position, **we'd like to hear from you.**

new_jobs.title: Project Manager REMOTE
new_jobs.description:
**Location:** Remote (CONUS) with availability during Eastern Time core hours


**Clearance:** Active Secret Clearance required


**Job Type:** Full\-time


**Contract Type:** Government Contract (Base Year \+ 4 Option Years)


### **Position Overview**



We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead a high\-impact contract supporting the Assistant Secretary of the Army for Acquisition, Logistics, and Technology (ASA(ALT)). This role provides overall management and oversight of contractor personnel supporting the Project Management Resource Tool (PMRT) program, which enables program offices to manage financial and programmatic data, automate processes, and provide data visualization for senior\-level decision\-making.



The ideal candidate is a certified project management professional with a proven track record managing Department of Defense (DoD) or Department of the Army (DA) financial and acquisition programs. This position serves as the single accountable manager for task order performance and acts as the primary interface with government leadership, including the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) and the Technical Point of Contact (TPOC).



This is a non\-personal services contract position. The Project Manager reports directly to the Prime Contractor for all human resources, disciplinary, and administrative matters, while receiving work direction and prioritization from government stakeholders.


### **Key Responsibilities**



The Project Manager serves as the single accountable manager for all task order performance, ensuring disciplined execution of approved plans, schedules, and governance processes. This position acts as the primary interface with government stakeholders, including the GSA AAS COR, ASA(ALT) TPOC, and other program authorities, and directs and coordinates cross\-functional contractor teams operating across multiple locations. Regular status briefings are provided to Government leadership on cost, schedule, performance, and risk, with a focus on timely communication, issue escalation, and resolution in support of Government decision\-making.



Contract and performance oversight includes managing and overseeing all activities performed by contractor personnel and subcontractors, ensuring compliance with all Performance Work Statement requirements and deliverables. The Project Manager develops and implements Transition\-In and Transition\-Out plans, coordinates the Project Kick\-Off Meeting and bi\-weekly Technical Status Meetings, and prepares Monthly Status Reports including risk registers and performance metrics. Additionally, this role maintains visibility into accumulated and projected costs, invoiced amounts, and labor utilization.



Quality and risk management responsibilities include administering quality management in accordance with the approved Quality Control Plan, managing risk registers, implementing corrective actions as required, ensuring all deliverables meet Section 508 compliance requirements, and overseeing personnel leave/absence planning and replacement procedures.



Key deliverables include Monthly Status Reports due by the 10th business day of each month, Project Kick\-Off Meeting coordination and minutes, Transition\-In and Transition\-Out Plans, Technical Status Meeting minutes, a Quality Control Plan, and a Personnel Leave/Absent Plan.


### **Required Qualifications**



The Project Manager must be a U.S. citizen with a current active Secret security clearance and possess a current project or program management certification such as PMP or PgMP. This position requires a minimum of five years of recent experience managing programs or supporting DoD financial systems of comparable size, scope, and complexity within the last seven years. Comprehensive knowledge of the Planning, Programming, Budgeting, and Execution (PPBE) process is essential, along with hands\-on experience with GFEBS and other defense business and accounting systems. The Project Manager must also maintain CMMC Level 1 status.



The ideal candidate demonstrates exceptional leadership abilities with a track record of leading cross\-functional teams and communicating effectively with senior government leadership. Strong judgment and the ability to make independent decisions to accomplish goals are essential.


### **Work Conditions**



Core hours are 0900 to 1600 Eastern Time, Monday through Friday. This position may be performed from anywhere CONUS, provided the candidate is readily available during core hours for on\-demand support, status reporting, and issue resolution. The Project Manager is designated as a "Key Person," and any proposed substitution requires written concurrence from the Contracting Officer with substitute qualifications equal to or greater than the original Key Person.


### **Equal Opportunity Employer**



We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

* Analyze DoW security policies and internal procedures to assess compliance, interpret requirements, identify potential impacts, and recommend process or performance improvements.
* Research security\-related issues through policy reviews, examination of existing records, and database queries; prepare recommendations, policy interpretations, reports, presentations, and other supporting documentation.
* Support a high\-volume customer service environment handling approximately 1,400 security requests per month across the team, including SIPRNet token, facility access, badge, and Visit Access Request actions; maintain customer communication and track requests through completion.
* Manage and monitor shared security mailbox traffic and compile weekly, end\-of\-month, and monthly metrics covering request volume, action type, status, completion time, trends, and other performance indicators.
* Support the security portions of personnel in\-processing and out\-processing, including transaction tracking and entries in the Defense Information System for Security (DISS) or a successor system.
* Assist Government\-led inquiries into potential security incidents by coordinating interviews, preparing reports, maintaining documentation, and tracking actions from initiation through closure.
* Maintain accurate information in security\-related systems, including access\-control databases, DISS, security rosters, eligibility and access records, Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) records, and accreditation documentation.
* Prepare analyses and briefings for Government program leads, senior management, stakeholders, and executive leadership concerning security program performance, compliance, risks, and emerging issues.
* Support records management, Mission Assurance, Continuity of Operations site relocation, and related activities, including compliance with applicable DoW, General Services Administration, and National Archives and Records Administration requirements.
* Support security programs such as Operations Security and Controlled Unclassified Information by coordinating meetings, agendas, minutes, presentations, training sessions, focus groups, research activities, and governance documentation.
* Assist with implementing and maintaining security procedures, checklists, process controls, document\-handling practices, and records\-destruction activities as directed by Government program leads.
* Support the annual Information Security Assistance Visit self\-inspection program, including scheduling, site visits, improvement recommendations, reports, metrics, trend analyses, and senior\-leadership briefing materials for an estimated 20 to 30 visits annually.
* Support security education and awareness activities by updating the Learning Management System and training requirements, preparing and delivering approximately five to 10 courses annually, and reporting training compliance.
* Prepare country\-specific risk assessments and foreign travel briefings in support of approximately 400 overseas travelers annually.
* Support SCI and collateral facility requirements for an inventory of more than 100 secure facilities, including accreditation documentation, physical security inspections, vulnerability identification, mitigation recommendations, and customer assistance in achieving DoW compliance.

 **Skills/Qualifications:** The ideal candidate is an analytical, detail\-oriented security professional who can effectively support multiple security functions in a fast\-paced Government environment. Specifically, the candidate will demonstrate the following:

* Working knowledge of Federal and DoW security policies, procedures, and compliance requirements across one or more security disciplines.
* Demonstrated ability to research and interpret policy, evaluate compliance, identify process gaps, and develop practical recommendations.

new_jobs.title: NPI Eng Program Manager, Amazon Devices Reverse Logistics
new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Lab126 is an inventive research and development company that designs and engineers high\-profile consumer electronics. Lab126 began in 2004 as a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc., originally creating the best\-selling Kindle family of products. Since then, we have produced ground breaking devices like Fire tablets, Fire TV and Amazon Echo. What will you help us create?  

  

The Role:  

As a Engineering Program Manager within the Hardware Service Engineering team you are responsible for defining the customer facing and internal strategy for the warranty and returns services of a new complex product. In addition to creating the overall returns service strategy, the role owns development of technical processes for dis\-assembly, assembly, spare parts reclamation, and development of tooling solutions to facilitate service operations.  

  

This includes defining, developing, deploying and sustaining hardware screening operations and repair/refurbishment processes globally to support Amazon Digital Device products. The role will be expected to use program management experience to share the overall strategy, gain cross\-functional support, and hold stakeholders accountable to the overall Reverse Logistics NPI strategy.  

  

In this role, you will:  

1\. Conduct detailed technical review and assessment of hardware designs at different product development phases, and drive design\-for\-serviceability (DFS) decisions during product concept and architecture phases that ensure component accessibility, modular assembly, and repair\-friendly layouts to optimize serviceability outcomes.  

2\. Provide actionable, engineering\-driven feedback on hardware design features during product development with a focus on design\-for\-serviceability (DFS).
  

3\. Own the repair service cost\-model, making appropriate trade\-offs to optimize cost and quality  

4\. Own defining customer return screening and repair strategy for warranty and remorse returns  

5\. Design and develop customer return screening and repair processes that optimize cost and product recovery  

6\. Apply Design of Experiment (DOE) methods to design and launch repeatable and reliable repair processes  

7\. Own defining and delivering key end customer facing outputs including customer facing repair documentation, repair service offerings, and spare parts offerings.  

8\. Partner with suppliers and manufacturers to validate that tooling, test fixtures, and service solutions align with product support requirements, warranty cost targets, and product launch schedules.  

9\. Develop programs to reduce the need for new spare parts through refurbishment of previous used parts and for improvements on warranty costs  

10\. Develop repair processes for continued improvements on efficiency and reduced complexity in the operations  

11\. Travel Required up to 20% (Domestic and International)  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Assess risk to service and repair customer offerings for new products beginning at concept.
* Enable closed loop feedback to product design and product management.
* Identify opportunities to improve the design for serviceability, design for repairability and go to market (GTM) strategy for aftermarket support and pre\-owned sales of Amazon Devices.
* Measure cost of service and repair against financial targets.

  

A day in the life  

As the overall owner of the NPI process within Reverse Logistics, on a daily basis, you will work with a broad cross\-functional team responsible for launching some of our most complex products. Your day will likely begin with updates from the European and Asian stakeholders for product launch. Then you will focus on documenting the plan of record for service and repair, with special focus on identifying serviceability and repairability improvement opportunities to reduce overall service and repair costs. Using your knowledge of repair processes you will submit requests for design changes to product design. To end your day you will work with product management, customer service, and SW tech teams to scope new customer facing service offerings required for the new Amazon product.
  

  

About the team  

Amazon Devices Reverse Logistics owns global warranty and services for all Amazon Device products. The team's vision is to power the circular economy by giving consumer electronic products another chance to be loved.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of customer\-facing product development and product management, including defining, launching, and optimizing product and services experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience leading cross\-functional teams to deliver products and online services on tight deadlines
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience working with Data \& AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage
* Experience in Reverse Logistics, Service Engineering, Product Design or Manufacturing Tooling and Process Development.
